					<!-- DGS Website Development Pune | syne-smooth-v1 | 2026-08-04 -->
<!--
ELEMENTOR HTML WIDGET VERSION — PUNE WEBSITE DEVELOPMENT LOCATION PAGE — RANKING EXPANDED
Paste this complete file into one Elementor HTML widget. This version adds verified proof, specialised subservice links, Why DGS and Pune relevance without changing the approved UI.
Do not add <!DOCTYPE>, <html>, <head> or <body> tags inside Elementor.
Set the outer Elementor container to Full Width and Overflow: Visible.
SEO title, description and canonical should remain in Rank Math/functions.php.
The global DGS footer already links to the principal service pages. This page adds only contextual links to the website-development subservice cluster.
-->
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Syne:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>

:root{
  --bg:#050508;
  --panel: rgba(16,20,38,0.22); /* TRANSPARENT */
  --panel-strong: rgba(16,20,38,0.38);
  --panel-ghost: rgba(16,20,38,0.12);
  --border:rgba(167,139,250,0.18);
  --border-2:rgba(167,139,250,0.42);
  --text:#f8fafc;
  --muted:#a8b0c0;
  --soft:#6b728f;
  --purple:#a78bfa;
  --pink:#ff4da0;
  --orange:#ff9f43;
  --cyan:#31e7ff;
  --lime:#9aff72;
  --gutter: clamp(16px, 3vw, 56px);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;padding:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);width:100%;max-width:100vw;overflow-x:clip}
body{font-family:"Syne",sans-serif; line-height:1.55; -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
img,svg,canvas,video{max-width:100%;display:block}
button,input,select,textarea{font-family:inherit}
.sr-only{position:absolute!important;width:1px!important;height:1px!important;padding:0!important;margin:-1px!important;overflow:hidden!important;clip:rect(0,0,0,0)!important;white-space:nowrap!important;border:0!important}
.inline-link{color:#c4b5fd;text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-color:rgba(196,181,253,.36);text-underline-offset:4px;font-weight:700}
.inline-link:hover,.inline-link:focus{color:#fff}
.svc-card[role="button"]{text-align:left;color:inherit;font:inherit;width:100%}
.svc-card:focus-visible,.faq-q:focus-visible,.modal-close:focus-visible,.btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--cyan);outline-offset:4px}
.form-glass .fluentform{position:relative;z-index:1}
.form-glass .ff-el-form-control{width:100%!important;padding:14px 16px!important;border-radius:12px!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03)!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)!important;color:#fff!important;font-family:inherit!important}
.form-glass .ff-el-form-control:focus{border-color:rgba(167,139,250,0.4)!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05)!important;box-shadow:none!important}
.form-glass label{color:#f8fafc!important;font-weight:700!important}
.form-glass .ff-btn-submit{width:100%!important;justify-content:center!important;padding:14px 22px!important;border:0!important;border-radius:999px!important;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--purple),var(--pink))!important;color:#fff!important;font-weight:800!important;box-shadow:0 16px 40px rgba(167,139,250,0.3)!important}

/* Global Transparent Starfield - ENTIRE PAGE */
#globalStarfield{
  position:fixed;
  inset:0;
  width:100vw;
  height:100vh;
  z-index:0;
  pointer-events:none;
  display:block;
  opacity:0.95;
}
.global-mesh{position:fixed; inset:0; pointer-events:none; z-index:1; overflow:hidden; opacity:0.55}
.orb{position:absolute; border-radius:50%; filter:blur(90px); mix-blend:screen; will-change:transform}
.orb1{width:92vw; height:92vw; max-width:980px; max-height:980px; left:-12%; top:-16%; background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, var(--purple), transparent 60%), radial-gradient(circle at 80% 80%, var(--pink), transparent 60%); animation:float1 18s ease-in-out infinite; opacity:0.32}
.orb2{width:74vw; height:74vw; max-width:860px; max-height:860px; right:-14%; top:18%; background:radial-gradient(circle, var(--cyan) 0%, transparent 65%); opacity:0.22}
.orb3{width:70vw; height:70vw; max-width:820px; max-height:820px; left:18%; bottom:-22%; background:radial-gradient(circle, var(--orange), transparent 60%), radial-gradient(circle at 70% 30%, var(--pink), transparent 55%); opacity:0.24}
@keyframes float1{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0) scale(1)}50%{transform:translate(3%,-4%) scale(1.08)}}
.grid-layer{position:absolute; inset:0; background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(167,139,250,0.05) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(167,139,250,0.04) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size:72px 72px; mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%, black 42%, transparent 86%); opacity:0.18}
.noise{position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:2; pointer-events:none; opacity:0.05; background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 400 400' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.9' numOctaves='4' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)'/%3E%3C/svg%3E")}
.scroll-progress{position:fixed; top:0; left:0; height:3px; width:100%; transform:scaleX(0); transform-origin:left center; background:linear-gradient(90deg, var(--purple), var(--pink), var(--cyan)); z-index:9999}
.cursor-dot{position:fixed; width:6px; height:6px; background:#fff; border-radius:50%; pointer-events:none; z-index:9998; mix-blend:difference; opacity:0}
.cursor-ring{position:fixed; width:36px; height:36px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.42); border-radius:50%; pointer-events:none; z-index:9997; mix-blend:difference; opacity:0}
@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){ .cursor-dot,.cursor-ring{opacity:1} }

.btn{position:relative; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:13px 22px; border-radius:999px; font-size:14px; font-weight:700; text-decoration:none; border:1px solid transparent; cursor:pointer; transition:all .32s; white-space:nowrap}
.btn-primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple), var(--pink)); color:#fff; box-shadow:0 16px 40px rgba(167,139,250,0.3)}
.btn-primary:hover{transform:translateY(-2px) scale(1.02); box-shadow:0 22px 60px rgba(255,77,160,0.38)}
.btn-ghost{background:rgba(15,18,34,0.18); border-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.12); color:#fff; backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}
.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--border-2); transform:translateY(-2px)}

main{position:relative; z-index:3; width:100%; max-width:100vw; overflow-x:clip}
.section{position:relative; width:100%; max-width:100vw; margin:0; padding: clamp(64px, 7.5vw, 128px) var(--gutter); overflow-x:clip}
.section-label{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:7px 13px; border-radius:999px; font-size:11px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:0.14em; text-transform:uppercase; background:rgba(167,139,250,0.08); border:1px solid var(--border); color:var(--purple); margin-bottom:18px; backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.dot{width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--purple); box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--purple); animation:pulse 2s infinite}
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}50%{transform:scale(1.5);opacity:.5}}
.h2{font-size:clamp(30px, 4.2vw, 58px); line-height:0.96; margin:0 0 16px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-0.035em; max-width:20ch}
.h2 i{font-style:normal; background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple), var(--pink) 32%, var(--orange) 66%, var(--cyan)); -webkit-background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; background-clip:text}
.p{font-size:clamp(14.5px, 1.12vw, 17.5px); line-height:1.72; color:var(--muted); max-width:66ch}
.marquee{position:relative; width:100vw; max-width:100vw; margin-left:calc(-1*var(--gutter)); margin-right:calc(-1*var(--gutter)); overflow:hidden; border-block:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); background:rgba(255,255,255,0.015); backdrop-filter:blur(10px); padding:14px 0}
.marquee-track{display:flex; gap:38px; white-space:nowrap; animation:marquee 38s linear infinite}
.marquee-item{font-weight:800; font-size:17px; letter-spacing:0.08em; text-transform:uppercase; color:transparent; -webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(255,255,255,0.18); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px}
.marquee-item b{color:rgba(255,255,255,0.72); -webkit-text-stroke:0}
.marquee-item .dot2{width:5px; height:5px; background:var(--pink); border-radius:50%; display:inline-block}
@keyframes marquee{0%{transform:translateX(0)}100%{transform:translateX(-50%)}}

/* HERO - different movement element */
.hero{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.12fr 0.88fr; gap: clamp(24px, 3.5vw, 64px); align-items:center; padding-top: clamp(108px,9vw,168px); padding-bottom: clamp(40px,6vw,72px); min-height:86vh; overflow:visible}
.hero-pill{display:inline-flex; gap:10px; align-items:center; padding:8px 14px; border-radius:999px; border:1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.26); background:rgba(15,15,28,0.32); backdrop-filter:blur(18px); font-size:11px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.14em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:18px}
.hero-h1{font-size:clamp(36px, 5.4vw, 82px); line-height:0.9; margin:0 0 18px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-0.05em}
.hero-h1 .outline{color:transparent; -webkit-text-stroke:1.35px rgba(255,255,255,0.30); display:block; font-weight:700}
.hero-h1 .grad{display:block; background:linear-gradient(105deg, var(--purple) 8%, var(--pink) 28%, var(--orange) 62%, var(--cyan) 92%); -webkit-background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; background-clip:text; background-size:200% 200%; animation:gradMove 8s ease infinite}
@keyframes gradMove{0%,100%{background-position:0% 50%}50%{background-position:100% 50%}}
.hero-sub{font-size:clamp(15px, 1.18vw, 18px); line-height:1.72; color:var(--muted); max-width:62ch; margin:0 0 26px}
.hero-ctas{display:flex; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:18px}
.hero-stats{display:flex; gap:12px; margin-top:20px; flex-wrap:wrap}
.stat{padding:13px 15px; border-radius:18px; background:var(--panel-ghost); border:1px solid var(--border); backdrop-filter:blur(18px); min-width:144px}
.stat-num{font-weight:800; font-size:22px; background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple), var(--pink)); -webkit-background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; background-clip:text}
.stat-lab{font-size:10px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.13em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--soft); margin-top:2px}
.hero-visual{position:relative; width:100%; height:clamp(540px,54vw,760px); display:grid; place-items:center; perspective:1300px; overflow:visible; padding-block:clamp(28px,3vw,52px)}
.hero-scene{position:relative; width:100%; height:100%; display:grid; place-items:center; transform-style:preserve-3d; transform:translateY(clamp(12px,1.5vw,24px))}
.scene-rings{position:absolute; inset:0; display:grid; place-items:center; pointer-events:none}
.ring{position:absolute; border-radius:50%; border:1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.22); box-shadow:inset 0 0 30px rgba(167,139,250,0.06); will-change:transform}
.ring::before{content:""; position:absolute; inset:-1px; border-radius:50%; padding:1px; background:conic-gradient(from 0deg, var(--purple), var(--pink), var(--cyan), var(--orange), var(--purple)); -webkit-mask:linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#fff 0 0); -webkit-mask-composite:xor; mask-composite:exclude; opacity:0.8}
.ring1{width:min(56vw,420px); height:min(56vw,420px); border-style:dashed; border-width:1px; animation:spin 24s linear infinite}
.ring2{width:min(72vw,560px); height:min(72vw,560px); animation:spin 36s linear infinite reverse; border-color:rgba(49,231,255,0.18)}
.ring3{width:min(86vw,680px); height:min(86vw,680px); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); animation:spin 68s linear infinite; opacity:0.5}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.photon-core{position:relative; width:min(46vw, 280px); height:min(46vw, 280px); border-radius:50%; background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #fff 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.9) 8%, var(--purple) 28%, var(--pink) 54%, var(--cyan) 82%); box-shadow:0 0 80px rgba(167,139,250,0.5), 0 0 140px rgba(255,77,160,0.28), inset 0 0 40px rgba(255,255,255,0.4); animation:photonPulse 4s ease-in-out infinite; z-index:2}
@keyframes photonPulse{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.06)}}
.photon-core::after{content:""; position:absolute; inset:18%; border-radius:50%; background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 20%, rgba(255,255,255,0.9), transparent 58%); mix-blend:overlay}
.photon-halo{position:absolute; width:min(62vw, 420px); height:min(62vw, 420px); border-radius:50%; background:radial-gradient(circle, rgba(167,139,250,0.22), transparent 70%); filter:blur(20px); animation:halo 6s ease-in-out infinite; pointer-events:none}
@keyframes halo{0%,100%{transform:scale(0.9); opacity:0.5}50%{transform:scale(1.15); opacity:0.8}}
.hero-fragments{position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; transform-style:preserve-3d}
.frag{position:absolute; padding:10px 14px; border-radius:999px; background:rgba(14,17,32,0.42); border:1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.26); backdrop-filter:blur(16px); font-size:11px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.04em; color:#e8e8ff; display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center; box-shadow:0 14px 36px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); will-change:transform}
.frag svg{width:16px; height:16px; color:var(--purple)}
.frag1{top:12%; right:10%; animation:fFloat1 5.8s ease-in-out infinite}
.frag2{bottom:20%; right:4%; animation:fFloat2 6.6s ease-in-out infinite}
.frag3{top:54%; left:2%; animation:fFloat3 6.2s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes fFloat1{0%,100%{transform:translate3d(0,0,30px)}50%{transform:translate3d(-12px,-16px,60px)}}
@keyframes fFloat2{0%,100%{transform:translate3d(0,0,20px)}50%{transform:translate3d(14px,-10px,50px)}}
@keyframes fFloat3{0%,100%{transform:translate3d(0,0,15px)}50%{transform:translate3d(-10px,12px,45px)}}
.hero-kinetic-lines{position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; overflow:hidden; opacity:0.18}
.hero-kinetic-lines span{position:absolute; width:1px; height:120px; background:linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, var(--purple), transparent); animation:lineFall linear infinite}
@keyframes lineFall{0%{transform:translateY(-140px)}100%{transform:translateY(780px)}}

/* Generic cards - all transparent now */
.answer-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.1fr 0.9fr; gap:28px; padding: clamp(22px, 2.8vw, 42px); border-radius:30px; background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(167,139,250,0.08), rgba(49,231,255,0.04)), var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.18); backdrop-filter:blur(22px); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(22px); width:100%}
.answer-side{display:grid; gap:12px; align-content:start}
.answer-chip{display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:center; padding:13px 15px; border-radius:16px; background:rgba(6,8,18,0.28); border:1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.14); color:#e6e8f2; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}
.answer-chip svg{width:18px; height:18px; stroke:var(--purple); stroke-width:2; fill:none}
.problem-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap: clamp(14px, 1.6vw, 24px)}
.p-card{padding: clamp(20px, 1.8vw, 28px); border-radius:26px; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); backdrop-filter:blur(18px); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px); transition:transform .4s, border-color .35s}
.p-card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px); border-color:var(--border-2); background:var(--panel-strong)}
.p-card-top{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:16px}
.p-icon{width:52px; height:52px; border-radius:16px; display:grid; place-items:center; background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,77,160,0.14), rgba(167,139,250,0.14)); border:1px solid rgba(255,77,160,0.18); color:var(--pink)}
.p-num{font-size:36px; font-weight:800; line-height:1; background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--pink), var(--purple)); -webkit-background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; background-clip:text}
.p-card h3{font-size:19px; margin:0 0 10px; font-weight:800}
.p-card p{color:var(--muted); font-size:14.5px; line-height:1.7; margin:0}
.proof-row{display:flex; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:22px}
.proof-row span{padding:9px 14px; border-radius:999px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); font-size:12px; font-weight:700}

/* SERVICES - fixed alignment to match other sections, still transparent */
.services-starfield{position:relative; width:100%; max-width:100vw; margin:0; padding: clamp(64px, 7.5vw, 128px) var(--gutter); background:transparent; border-block:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); overflow:hidden; isolation:isolate}
.services-starfield .svc-content,
.services-starfield .h2,
.services-starfield .p{margin-left:0; margin-right:0; text-align:left}
.services-starfield .svc-hint{justify-content:flex-start}
.svc-content{position:relative; z-index:2; width:100%; max-width:100%; margin:0 auto}
.svc-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3, minmax(0,1fr)); gap: clamp(14px, 1.8vw, 22px); margin-top:28px}
.svc-card{position:relative; padding: clamp(22px, 1.9vw, 28px); border-radius:22px; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); backdrop-filter:blur(18px); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px); transition:transform .35s, border-color .35s, background .35s, box-shadow .35s; cursor:pointer}
.svc-card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px); border-color:var(--border-2); background:var(--panel-strong); box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.24), 0 0 40px rgba(167,139,250,0.12)}
.svc-num{font-size:11px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:0.16em; color:var(--soft); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px}
.svc-num::before{content:""; width:22px; height:1px; background:var(--purple); display:inline-block}
.svc-card h4{font-size:19px; line-height:1.24; margin:12px 0 8px; font-weight:800}
.svc-card p{margin:0; color:var(--muted); font-size:13.8px; line-height:1.65}
.svc-line{width:28px; height:2px; background:var(--purple); margin-top:14px; transition:width .35s, background .35s}
.svc-card:hover .svc-line{width:48px; background:var(--pink)}
.svc-hint{margin-top:26px; display:flex; gap:12px; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; color:var(--soft); font-size:12px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.06em}
.svc-hint span{padding:8px 12px; border-radius:999px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06)}

/* modal */
.service-modal{position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:100; display:none; place-items:center; padding:20px; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.52); backdrop-filter:blur(22px)}
.service-modal.active{display:grid}
.modal-box{width:100%; max-width:540px; border-radius:28px; background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(22,24,48,0.92), rgba(12,14,28,0.96)); border:1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.28); padding:36px; position:relative; box-shadow:0 30px 90px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); backdrop-filter:blur(24px)}
.modal-close{position:absolute; top:14px; right:14px; width:36px; height:36px; border-radius:50%; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); color:#fff; display:grid; place-items:center; cursor:pointer}
.modal-num{font-size:11px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:0.14em; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:999px; background:rgba(167,139,250,0.12); border:1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.18); color:var(--purple)}
.modal-box h3{font-size:30px; margin:14px 0 12px; font-weight:800}
.modal-box p{color:var(--muted); font-size:15px; line-height:1.7}
.feat-list{display:grid; gap:10px; margin:18px 0 22px; padding:0}
.feat-list li{list-style:none; padding:12px 14px; border-radius:12px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); font-size:14px; font-weight:600}

/* tech */
.tech-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr); gap:16px; width:100%}
.t-card{padding:22px 18px; border-radius:22px; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); backdrop-filter:blur(16px); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px); transition:all .35s}
.t-card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px); border-color:var(--border-2); background:var(--panel-strong)}
.t-logo{width:52px; height:52px; border-radius:16px; display:grid; place-items:center; background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(167,139,250,0.14), rgba(49,231,255,0.08)); border:1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.18); color:#c9bbff; margin-bottom:16px}
.t-logo svg{width:28px; height:28px; stroke:currentColor; fill:none; stroke-width:1.8}
.t-card h3{font-size:16px; margin:0 0 8px; font-weight:800}
.t-card p{font-size:13.5px; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.6; margin:0}
.table-wrap{overflow:auto; border-radius:22px; border:1px solid var(--border); background:var(--panel); backdrop-filter:blur(18px); width:100%}
.dec-table{width:100%; min-width:720px; border-collapse:collapse}
.dec-table th{padding:18px 20px; font-size:11px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:0.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#fff; background:rgba(167,139,250,0.08); text-align:left; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06)}
.dec-table td{padding:18px 20px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color:var(--muted); font-size:14px; line-height:1.6}
.dec-table td:first-child{color:#fff; font-weight:700; width:28%}

/* process */
.process-wrap{position:relative; width:100%}
.timeline-line{position:absolute; left:50%; top:0; bottom:0; width:2px; background:linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, var(--purple) 10%, var(--pink) 50%, var(--cyan) 90%, transparent); transform:translateX(-50%); opacity:.4}
.proc-grid{display:grid; gap:26px; width:100%}
.proc-step{position:relative; display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:24px; align-items:start; width:100%}
.proc-step:nth-child(even){direction:rtl}
.proc-step:nth-child(even) *{direction:ltr}
.proc-card{padding:24px; border-radius:24px; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); backdrop-filter:blur(18px)}
.proc-card:hover{border-color:var(--border-2); transform:translateY(-4px); background:var(--panel-strong)}
.proc-num{width:46px; height:46px; border-radius:50%; display:grid; place-items:center; background:rgba(167,139,250,0.1); border:1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.3); font-weight:800; font-size:13px; color:#fff}

/* why, readiness */
.split{display:grid; grid-template-columns:0.95fr 1.05fr; gap: clamp(20px, 3vw, 42px); width:100%}
.check-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr); gap:12px}
.check-item{display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:flex-start; padding:14px; border-radius:16px; background:var(--panel-ghost); border:1px solid var(--border); font-size:13.5px; font-weight:600; backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}
.check-item svg{width:18px; height:18px; stroke:var(--purple); stroke-width:2.2; fill:none; margin-top:2px; flex-shrink:0}
.r-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:18px; width:100%}
.r-card{padding:26px; border-radius:22px; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}
.r-card h3{font-size:18px; margin:0 0 10px; font-weight:800}
.r-card p{font-size:14px; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.7; margin:0}

/* RECENT WORK - 3 SECTIONS transparent */
.recent-work{display:grid; gap: clamp(22px, 2.5vw, 36px); width:100%; margin-top:22px}
.work-section{display:grid; gap:18px; padding: clamp(20px, 2.2vw, 32px); border-radius:28px; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); backdrop-filter:blur(18px); width:100%; position:relative; overflow:hidden}
.work-section::before{content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; background:radial-gradient(circle at 12% 18%, rgba(167,139,250,0.08), transparent 42%); pointer-events:none}
.work-section-header{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-end; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap; position:relative; z-index:1}
.work-kicker{font-size:11px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:0.16em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--purple); display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center}
.work-kicker::before{content:""; width:18px; height:1px; background:var(--purple); display:inline-block}
.work-featured{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.15fr 0.85fr; gap:22px; align-items:start; position:relative; z-index:1}
.work-featured .w-img{position:relative; aspect-ratio:16/10; border-radius:20px; overflow:hidden; background:rgba(14,14,28,0.4); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06)}
.work-featured .w-img img{width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; transition:transform .6s}
.work-featured:hover .w-img img{transform:scale(1.04)}
.work-year{position:absolute; top:12px; right:12px; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:999px; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.62); border:1px solid rgba(255,159,67,0.26); color:var(--orange); font-size:11px; font-weight:800; backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.work-body h3{font-size:28px; margin:0 0 8px; font-weight:800; background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--pink), var(--orange), var(--cyan)); -webkit-background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; background-clip:text}
.work-body .w-sub{color:var(--soft); font-size:11px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.12em; text-transform:uppercase}
.work-body p{color:var(--muted); font-size:14px; line-height:1.66; margin:12px 0 16px}
.work-meta{display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap}
.work-meta span{padding:7px 10px; border-radius:999px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); font-weight:600}
.work-grid-2{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr); gap:18px; position:relative; z-index:1}
.w-card{border-radius:22px; overflow:hidden; background:rgba(10,12,24,0.32); border:1px solid var(--border); backdrop-filter:blur(14px); display:flex; flex-direction:column; transition:transform .35s, border-color .35s, background .35s}
.w-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px); border-color:var(--border-2); background:rgba(10,12,24,0.48)}
.w-card .w-img{aspect-ratio:16/10; position:relative; overflow:hidden; background:rgba(16,16,30,0.4)}
.w-card .w-img img{width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; transition:transform .6s}
.w-card:hover .w-img img{transform:scale(1.06)}
.w-card .w-body{padding:18px}
.w-card .w-body h4{font-size:20px; margin:0 0 6px; font-weight:800}
.work-closing{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 0.9fr; gap:18px; align-items:stretch; position:relative; z-index:1}
.cta-panel{border-radius:22px; padding:26px; background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(167,139,250,0.12), rgba(255,77,160,0.12)); border:1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.22); display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}

/* AMC */
.amc-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:18px; width:100%}
.amc-card{position:relative; padding:28px; border-radius:24px; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); backdrop-filter:blur(16px); transition:all .35s}
.amc-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px); background:var(--panel-strong)}
.amc-num{font-size:64px; font-weight:900; line-height:1; opacity:0.12; background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple), var(--pink)); -webkit-background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; background-clip:text}
.logos-wrap{margin-top:32px; padding:32px; border-radius:28px; background:var(--panel-ghost); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); backdrop-filter:blur(14px); width:100%}
.logos-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(5, minmax(0,1fr)); gap:18px; width:100%}
.logo-item{display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:10px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.02); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border-radius:18px; padding:18px; transition:.3s}
.logo-item img{width:100%; max-width:112px; height:48px; object-fit:contain}
.logo-item span{font-size:11px; font-weight:700; color:var(--soft); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.08em; text-align:center}

/* cost */
.cost-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:18px; width:100%}
.cost-card{padding:26px; border-radius:22px; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}

/* FAQ */
.faq-wrap{max-width:980px; margin:0 auto; width:100%}
.faq-list{display:grid; gap:14px}
.faq-item{border-radius:18px; background:var(--panel-ghost); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); overflow:hidden; backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}
.faq-item.active{border-color:rgba(255,77,160,0.38); background:rgba(255,77,160,0.06)}
.faq-q{width:100%; text-align:left; background:transparent; border:0; color:#fff; padding:20px 22px; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:16px; cursor:pointer; font-size:16px; font-weight:700}
.faq-icon{width:34px; height:34px; border-radius:50%; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14); display:grid; place-items:center; flex-shrink:0; transition:all .3s; font-size:18px}
.faq-item.active .faq-icon{transform:rotate(45deg); border-color:var(--pink); background:rgba(255,77,160,0.1)}
.faq-a{display:grid; grid-template-rows:0fr; transition:grid-template-rows .35s}
.faq-item.active .faq-a{grid-template-rows:1fr}
.faq-a-inner{overflow:hidden}
.faq-a-inner p{padding:0 22px 22px; margin:0; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.7; font-size:14.5px}
.form-glass{margin-top:38px; padding: clamp(20px, 2.6vw, 36px); border-radius:28px; background:var(--panel-ghost); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); backdrop-filter:blur(18px); width:100%}
.form-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:14px; width:100%}
.input{width:100%; padding:14px 16px; border-radius:12px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color:#fff; font-size:14px; outline:none}
.input:focus{border-color:rgba(167,139,250,0.4); background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05)}
textarea.input{grid-column:1/-1; min-height:120px; resize:vertical}

/* 4K */
@media (min-width: 1920px){
  :root{ --gutter: clamp(64px, 4.5vw, 120px); }
  .section{ padding: clamp(88px, 6vw, 160px) var(--gutter); }
  .h2{ font-size: clamp(44px, 3.2vw, 76px); }
  .hero-h1{ font-size: clamp(54px, 4.6vw, 104px) }
}
@media (min-width: 2560px){
  :root{ --gutter: clamp(96px, 5vw, 180px); }
  html{ font-size:17px }
  #globalStarfield{ opacity:1 }
}
@media (max-width: 1180px){
  .hero{grid-template-columns:1fr; min-height:auto}
  .hero{padding-top:clamp(96px,11vw,132px)}
  .hero-visual{height:clamp(580px,72vw,700px); order:-1; padding-block:36px}
  .svc-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .problem-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .tech-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
  .r-grid,.cost-grid,.amc-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .logos-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
  .split{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .proc-step{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .timeline-line{left:18px; transform:none}
  .work-featured, .work-grid-2, .work-closing{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .services-starfield{margin-left:0; margin-right:0; width:100%; max-width:100vw}
}
@media (max-width: 760px){
  :root{ --gutter: 18px }
  .section{padding:56px var(--gutter)}
  .hero{padding-top:clamp(88px,20vw,118px)}
  .hero-visual{height:460px; padding-block:34px; margin-bottom:8px}
  .hero-scene{transform:translateY(14px)}
  .problem-grid,.tech-grid,.r-grid,.cost-grid,.amc-grid,.form-grid,.check-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .logos-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .svc-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .cursor-dot,.cursor-ring{display:none!important}
  .ring3{display:none}
}
@media (max-width: 380px){
  :root{ --gutter: 14px }
  .btn{width:100%; justify-content:center}
}

/* =========================================================
   ELEMENTOR HTML WIDGET RUNTIME FIX
   The full-page background is moved to document.body by JS.
   These rules override page/template/container backgrounds,
   including Elementor background overlays and pseudo layers.
   ========================================================= */
html.dgs-webdev-active,
html.dgs-webdev-active body.dgs-webdev-active{
  background:#050508 !important;
  background-color:#050508 !important;
  background-image:none !important;
  min-height:100% !important;
}

body.dgs-webdev-active::before,
body.dgs-webdev-active::after{
  background:transparent !important;
  background-color:transparent !important;
  background-image:none !important;
  opacity:0 !important;
  pointer-events:none !important;
}

body.dgs-webdev-active #dgs-global-bg-root{
  position:fixed !important;
  inset:0 !important;
  width:100vw !important;
  height:100vh !important;
  z-index:0 !important;
  display:block !important;
  visibility:visible !important;
  opacity:1 !important;
  overflow:hidden !important;
  pointer-events:none !important;
  background-color:#050508 !important;
  background-image:

<section class="section compact-section" id="development-process">
<div class="section-label"><span class="dot"></span> Website Development Process</div>
<h2 class="h2">A Clear Process from <i>Discovery to Launch and AMC</i></h2>
<p class="p">A structured process reduces avoidable revisions, keeps content and development aligned and makes technical responsibilities clear before launch.</p>
<div class="process-grid-new">
<article class="process-step-new"><span>01</span><h3>Discovery and objectives</h3><p>Business goals, audience, competitors, content, integrations, timelines and measurable conversion priorities.</p></article>
<article class="process-step-new"><span>02</span><h3>Sitemap and search planning</h3><p>Page hierarchy, keyword intent, navigation, internal links, URL structure and content requirements.</p></article>
<article class="process-step-new"><span>03</span><h3>UI/UX and content flow</h3><p>Responsive layouts, visual hierarchy, trust signals, calls to action and reusable component planning.</p></article>
<article class="process-step-new"><span>04</span><h3>Development and integrations</h3><p>CMS or custom build, forms, APIs, analytics, technical SEO controls and reusable frontend components.</p></article>
<article class="process-step-new"><span>05</span><h3>QA, migration and launch</h3><p>Device testing, performance checks, redirects, metadata, forms, analytics, indexing and launch validation.</p></article>
<article class="process-step-new"><span>06</span><h3>Measurement and AMC</h3><p>Post-launch monitoring, content updates, technical support, security, backups and improvement planning.</p></article>
</div>
</section>
<section class="section compact-section" id="industries">
<div class="section-label"><span class="dot"></span> Industries and Website Requirements</div>
<h2 class="h2">Website Development for <i>Different Business Models</i></h2>
<p class="p">Industry experience matters because page structure, trust signals, content depth, integrations and enquiry journeys vary by business model. Our approach adapts the technology and content architecture rather than forcing every project into the same template.</p>
<div class="industry-grid">
<article><h3>B2B and professional services</h3><p>Clear service architecture, expertise proof, case studies, lead qualification and decision-maker journeys.</p></article>
<article><h3>Finance and regulated categories</h3><p>Structured information, trust, disclosures, accessible content, controlled updates and secure enquiry paths.</p></article>
<article><h3>Education and training</h3><p>Programme discovery, admission enquiries, faculty and credibility content, events and scalable publishing.</p></article>
<article><h3>Staffing and workforce solutions</h3><p>Employer and candidate journeys, service discovery, location content, lead forms and recruitment workflows.</p></article>
<article><h3>Consumer and lifestyle brands</h3><p>Brand storytelling, product or service discovery, campaigns, mobile-first experiences and conversion tracking.</p></article>
<article><h3>Technology and sustainability</h3><p>Complex proposition explanation, solution architecture, credibility signals, resources and investor or partner journeys.</p></article>
</div>
</section>
<section class="section" id="amc">
<div class="section-label"><span class="dot"></span> Website Maintenance & AMC</div>
<h2 class="h2">Annual Maintenance Contracts for <i>Long-Term Website Stability</i></h2>
<p class="p">Website AMC keeps the live website monitored, updated, backed up and ready for ongoing business changes. The exact support plan is defined according to the platform, website size, update frequency and response requirements.</p>
<div class="amc-grid" style="margin-top:22px">
<article class="amc-card"><div class="amc-num">01</div><h3 style="font-weight:800">Proactive Monitoring</h3><p class="p" style="font-size:14px">Scheduled uptime, form and performance checks with issue alerts and documented follow-up.</p></article>
<article class="amc-card"><div class="amc-num">02</div><h3 style="font-weight:800">Security & Backups</h3><p class="p" style="font-size:14px">Security reviews, malware checks, backup management and recovery support according to the agreed plan.</p></article>
<article class="amc-card"><div class="amc-num">03</div><h3 style="font-weight:800">Regular Updates</h3><p class="p" style="font-size:14px">WordPress core, theme and plugin updates with compatibility checks and staged testing where applicable.</p></article>
<article class="amc-card"><div class="amc-num">04</div><h3 style="font-weight:800">Performance Tuning</h3><p class="p" style="font-size:14px">Caching, image delivery, script review, database housekeeping and Core Web Vitals monitoring.</p></article>
<article class="amc-card"><div class="amc-num">05</div><h3 style="font-weight:800">Content Support</h3><p class="p" style="font-size:14px">Planned updates to pages, banners, blogs, forms and campaign content within the AMC scope.</p></article>
<article class="amc-card"><div class="amc-num">06</div><h3 style="font-weight:800">Technical Support</h3><p class="p" style="font-size:14px">Issue resolution, change requests, integration assistance and technical guidance for the website team.</p></article>
</div>
</section>
<section class="section" id="mumbai-service-area">
<div class="local-panel">
<div class="section-label"><span class="dot"></span> Pune Website Development Coverage</div>
<h2 class="h2" style="max-width:none">Website Development Services Across <i>Pune and Nearby Business Hubs</i></h2>
<p class="p" style="max-width:78ch">D'Genius Solutions supports startups, SMEs, manufacturers, technology companies, education brands, healthcare businesses and professional-service firms across Pune. <div class="faq-item"><button aria-controls="faq-a-2" aria-expanded="false" class="faq-q" id="faq-q-2" type="button">Which website platforms and technologies do you work with? <span aria-hidden="true" class="faq-icon">+</span></button><div aria-labelledby="faq-q-2" class="faq-a" id="faq-a-2" role="region"><div class="faq-a-inner"><p>We work with WordPress, WooCommerce, HTML5, CSS and SCSS, JavaScript, React, Next.js and PHP. <div class="faq-item"><button aria-controls="faq-a-3" aria-expanded="false" class="faq-q" id="faq-q-3" type="button">How long does it take to design and develop a website? <span aria-hidden="true" class="faq-icon">+</span></button><div aria-labelledby="faq-q-3" class="faq-a" id="faq-a-3" role="region"><div class="faq-a-inner"><p>A focused business website may take approximately four to six weeks, while larger websites, e-commerce builds or custom integrations may require eight to twelve weeks or more. <div class="faq-item"><button aria-controls="faq-a-4" aria-expanded="false" class="faq-q" id="faq-q-4" type="button">How is website development pricing calculated? <span aria-hidden="true" class="faq-icon">+</span></button><div aria-labelledby="faq-q-4" class="faq-a" id="faq-a-4" role="region"><div class="faq-a-inner"><p>Pricing is based on the number of page templates, content volume, UI/UX complexity, CMS requirements, e-commerce or custom functionality, integrations, migration, SEO setup and testing. <div class="faq-item"><button aria-controls="faq-a-5" aria-expanded="false" class="faq-q" id="faq-q-5" type="button">Is SEO included in website development? <span aria-hidden="true" class="faq-icon">+</span></button><div aria-labelledby="faq-q-5" class="faq-a" id="faq-a-5" role="region"><div class="faq-a-inner"><p>Each website can include technical SEO foundations such as semantic headings, crawlable navigation, clean URLs, metadata fields, canonicals, sitemap readiness, redirects and schema coordination. <div class="faq-item"><button aria-controls="faq-a-6" aria-expanded="false" class="faq-q" id="faq-q-6" type="button">How do you prepare websites for AI Overviews and AI-assisted discovery? <span aria-hidden="true" class="faq-icon">+</span></button><div aria-labelledby="faq-q-6" class="faq-a" id="faq-a-6" role="region"><div class="faq-a-inner"><p>We focus on the same strong foundations required for Google Search: crawlable HTML, clear service definitions, useful answer-first passages, descriptive internal links, consistent organisation details, accessible page structure and technically indexable content. <div class="faq-item"><button aria-controls="faq-a-7" aria-expanded="false" class="faq-q" id="faq-q-7" type="button">Can you redesign an existing website without damaging its SEO? <span aria-hidden="true" class="faq-icon">+</span></button><div aria-labelledby="faq-q-7" class="faq-a" id="faq-a-7" role="region"><div class="faq-a-inner"><p>Yes. <div class="faq-item"><button aria-controls="faq-a-9" aria-expanded="false" class="faq-q" id="faq-q-9" type="button">Will the website work on mobile, desktop and 4K screens? <span aria-hidden="true" class="faq-icon">+</span></button><div aria-labelledby="faq-q-9" class="faq-a" id="faq-a-9" role="region"><div class="faq-a-inner"><p>Yes. <div class="faq-item"><button aria-controls="faq-a-10" aria-expanded="false" class="faq-q" id="faq-q-10" type="button">How do I choose among the best website development companies in Pune? <span aria-hidden="true" class="faq-icon">+</span></button><div aria-labelledby="faq-q-10" class="faq-a" id="faq-a-10" role="region"><div class="faq-a-inner"><p>Compare relevant case studies, the clarity of the proposed process, technology recommendations, responsive testing, SEO foundations, analytics setup, ownership terms and the support available after launch. <script>
(function(){
  document.documentElement.classList.add('dgs-webdev-active');
  document.body.classList.add('dgs-webdev-active');
  const initialBgRoot=document.getElementById('dgs-global-bg-root');
  if(initialBgRoot&&initialBgRoot.parentNode!==document.body){
    document.body.insertBefore(initialBgRoot,document.body.firstChild);
  }

  function bootDgsWebDevPage(){
    if(window.__dgsWebDevPageBooted) return;
    window.__dgsWebDevPageBooted=true;
    const reduceMotion=window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    const saveData=Boolean(navigator.connection&&navigator.connection.saveData);

    /* Remove inherited Elementor/theme full-height settings from the HTML widget host. */
    const pageRoot=document.getElementById('dgs-webdev-page');
    const widgetHost=pageRoot?pageRoot.closest('.elementor-widget-html'):null;
    if(widgetHost){
      widgetHost.classList.add('dgs-webdev-host');
      const widgetContainer=widgetHost.querySelector(':scope > .elementor-widget-container');
      if(widgetContainer) widgetContainer.classList.add('dgs-webdev-host');
      let ancestor=widgetHost.parentElement;
      let depth=0;
      while(ancestor&&depth<5){
        if(ancestor.matches('.e-con,.e-con-inner,.elementor-section,.elementor-container,.elementor-column,.elementor-widget-wrap')) ancestor.classList.add('dgs-webdev-host-parent');
        ancestor=ancestor.parentElement;
        depth++;
      }
    }

    /* Native progress bar: no GSAP or ScrollTrigger dependency. */
    const progressEl=document.getElementById('progress');
    let progressTicking=false;
    function updateProgress(){
      const doc=document.documentElement;
      const max=Math.max(1,doc.scrollHeight-window.innerHeight);
      progressEl.style.transform='scaleX('+Math.min(1,Math.max(0,window.scrollY/max))+')';
      progressTicking=false;
    }
    window.addEventListener('scroll',()=>{ if(!progressTicking){ progressTicking=true; requestAnimationFrame(updateProgress); } },{passive:true});
    updateProgress();

    /* Cursor follows only on fine pointers and sleeps when it reaches the pointer. */
    const finePointer=window.matchMedia('(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine)').matches;
    const cDot=document.getElementById('cDot'), cRing=document.getElementById('cRing');
    let mx=0,my=0,rx=0,ry=0,cursorRaf=0;
    function animateCursor(){
      rx+=(mx-rx)*.18; ry+=(my-ry)*.18;
      cRing.style.transform='translate3d('+(rx-18)+'px,'+(ry-18)+'px,0)';
      if(Math.abs(mx-rx)+Math.abs(my-ry)>.25) cursorRaf=requestAnimationFrame(animateCursor); else cursorRaf=0;
    }
    if(finePointer){
      window.addEventListener('pointermove',event=>{
        mx=event.clientX; my=event.clientY;
        cDot.style.transform='translate3d('+(mx-3)+'px,'+(my-3)+'px,0)';
        if(!cursorRaf) cursorRaf=requestAnimationFrame(animateCursor);
      },{passive:true});
    }

    /* Lightweight hero parallax: one requestAnimationFrame, no tween creation on every pointer move. */
    const heroVisual=document.getElementById('heroVisual'), r1=document.getElementById('ring1'), r2=document.getElementById('ring2'), r3=document.getElementById('ring3'), photon=document.getElementById('photon'), halo=document.getElementById('halo');
    const frags=[document.getElementById('frag1'),document.getElementById('frag2'),document.getElementById('frag3')];
    const kLines=document.getElementById('kineticLines');
    const kineticCount=(reduceMotion||saveData)?0:(window.innerWidth<=760?0:4);
    for(let i=0;i<kineticCount;i++){ const s=document.createElement('span'); s.style.left=(Math.random()*100)+'%'; s.style.animationDuration=(3+Math.random()*3)+'s'; s.style.animationDelay=(Math.random()*2)+'s'; s.style.opacity=(.18+Math.random()*.35).toFixed(2); kLines.appendChild(s); }
    if(heroVisual&&!reduceMotion&&!saveData&&finePointer){
      let heroX=0,heroY=0,heroQueued=false;
      const applyHero=()=>{
        const transforms=[[r1,heroX*26,heroY*18],[r2,heroX*19,heroY*13],[r3,heroX*12,heroY*8],[photon,heroX*12,heroY*10],[halo,heroX*15,heroY*12]];
        transforms.forEach(([el,x,y])=>{ if(el) el.style.translate=x+'px '+y+'px'; });
        frags.forEach((el,index)=>{ if(el) el.style.translate=(heroX*(22+index*7))+'px '+(heroY*(16+index*5))+'px'; });
        heroQueued=false;
      };
      heroVisual.addEventListener('pointermove',event=>{
        const rect=heroVisual.getBoundingClientRect();
        heroX=(event.clientX-rect.left-rect.width/2)/rect.width;
        heroY=(event.clientY-rect.top-rect.height/2)/rect.height;
        if(!heroQueued){ heroQueued=true; requestAnimationFrame(applyHero); }
      },{passive:true});
      heroVisual.addEventListener('pointerleave',()=>{ heroX=0; heroY=0; if(!heroQueued){ heroQueued=true; requestAnimationFrame(applyHero); } },{passive:true});
    }

// GLOBAL TRANSPARENT STARFIELD — SMOOTH ADAPTIVE VERSION WITH CLICK / PRESS WARP
(function initGlobalStarfield(){
  const canvas=document.getElementById('globalStarfield');
  if(!canvas) return;

  const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d',{alpha:true,desynchronized:true});
  if(!ctx) return;

  const coarsePointer=window.matchMedia('(pointer:coarse)').matches;
  const STAR_COLORS=['#a78bfa','#ff4da0','#ff9f43','#31e7ff','#9aff72','#ffffff','#c4b5fd'];
  const FL=400;

  let width=window.innerWidth;
  let height=window.innerHeight;
  let dpr=1;
  let centerX=width*.5;
  let centerY=height*.5;
  let pointerTargetX=centerX;
  let pointerTargetY=centerY;
  let pointerX=centerX;
  let pointerY=centerY;
  let particles=[];
  let rafId=0;
  let lastRender=0;
  let lastUpdate=performance.now();
  let hidden=document.hidden;
  let isScrolling=false;
  let scrollTimer=0;
  let resizeTimer=0;
  let pointerHeld=false;
  let boostUntil=0;

  const baseSpeed=(reduceMotion||saveData)?.22:.78;
  const boostSpeed=(reduceMotion||saveData)?1.4:10.5;
  let targetSpeed=baseSpeed;
  let currentSpeed=baseSpeed;

  function particleCount(){
    if(saveData) return 18;
    if(width>1920) return 72;
    if(width>1280) return 58;
    if(width>760) return 42;
    return 30;
  }

  function targetFps(){
    if(reduceMotion||saveData) return 20;
    if(width<=760) return isScrolling?24:30;
    return isScrolling?30:45;
  }

  class Particle{
    constructor(initial=false){ this.reset(initial); }
    reset(initial=false){
      this.x=(Math.random()-.5)*width*1.35;
      this.y=(Math.random()-.5)*height*1.35;
      this.z=initial?Math.random()*1500+160:Math.random()*1050+500;
      this.pz=this.z;
      this.color=STAR_COLORS[(Math.random()*STAR_COLORS.length)|0];
      this.baseR=.42+Math.random()*1.05;
      this.trail=Math.random()>.55;
    }
  }

  function resize(){
    width=window.innerWidth;
    height=window.innerHeight;
    dpr=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,width<=760?1:1.1);

    canvas.width=Math.max(1,Math.round(width*dpr));
    canvas.height=Math.max(1,Math.round(height*dpr));
    canvas.style.width=width+'px';
    canvas.style.height=height+'px';
    ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);

    centerX=width*.5;
    centerY=height*.5;
    pointerTargetX=centerX;
    pointerTargetY=centerY;
    pointerX=centerX;
    pointerY=centerY;
    particles=Array.from({length:particleCount()},()=>new Particle(true));
  }

  function setBoost(active){
    const now=performance.now();
    if(active){
      pointerHeld=true;
      boostUntil=now+700;
      targetSpeed=boostSpeed;
      currentSpeed=Math.max(currentSpeed,2.4);
      canvas.dataset.warp='active';
    }else{
      pointerHeld=false;
      if(now>=boostUntil){
        targetSpeed=baseSpeed;
        delete canvas.dataset.warp;
      }
    }
  }

  function updateInteraction(now){
    if(!pointerHeld&&now>=boostUntil&&targetSpeed!==baseSpeed){
      targetSpeed=baseSpeed;
      delete canvas.dataset.warp;
    }
  }

  function render(now){
    rafId=requestAnimationFrame(render);
    if(hidden) return;

    const fps=targetFps();
    const frameInterval=1000/fps;
    if(now-lastRender<frameInterval) return;

    const elapsed=Math.min(50,Math.max(1,now-lastUpdate));
    const dt60=elapsed/16.6667;
    lastUpdate=now;
    lastRender=now-(now-lastRender)%frameInterval;

    updateInteraction(now);

    const speedEase=1-Math.pow(.84,dt60);
    currentSpeed+=(targetSpeed-currentSpeed)*speedEase;

    const pointerEase=1-Math.pow(.88,dt60);
    pointerX+=(pointerTargetX-pointerX)*pointerEase;
    pointerY+=(pointerTargetY-pointerY)*pointerEase;

    ctx.clearRect(0,0,width,height);

    const cx=centerX+(pointerX-centerX)*.10;
    const cy=centerY+(pointerY-centerY)*.10;
    const warp=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(currentSpeed-baseSpeed)/(boostSpeed-baseSpeed)));

    for(const p of particles){
      p.pz=p.z;
      p.z-=currentSpeed*dt60;
      if(p.z<=4){ p.reset(false); continue; }

      const f=FL/p.z;
      const pf=FL/p.pz;
      const x=cx+p.x*f;
      const y=cy+p.y*f;
      if(x<-50||x>width+50||y<-50||y>height+50) continue;

      const px=cx+p.x*pf;
      const py=cy+p.y*pf;
      const depthAlpha=Math.min(.9,Math.max(.16,(1550-p.z)/1250));
      const r=Math.max(.48,p.baseR*f*(1+warp*.35));

      if(p.trail||warp>.08){
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.strokeStyle=p.color;
        ctx.globalAlpha=depthAlpha*(.20+warp*.62);
        ctx.lineWidth=Math.max(.32,r*(.48+warp*.55));
        ctx.moveTo(px,py);
        ctx.lineTo(x,y);
        ctx.stroke();
      }

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.fillStyle=p.color;
      ctx.globalAlpha=depthAlpha*(.72+warp*.22);
      ctx.arc(x,y,r,0,Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  }

  resize();
  rafId=requestAnimationFrame(render);

  window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{
    clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
    resizeTimer=setTimeout(()=>{
      resize();
      lastUpdate=performance.now();
      lastRender=0;
    },160);
  },{passive:true});

  if(!reduceMotion&&!saveData){
    window.addEventListener('pointermove',event=>{
      pointerTargetX=event.clientX;
      pointerTargetY=event.clientY;
    },{passive:true});
  }

  /* Capture phase means the warp still triggers when the press begins on a card or CTA. */
  window.addEventListener('pointerdown',event=>{
    if(event.isPrimary===false) return;
    if(typeof event.button==='number'&&event.button!==0) return;
    setBoost(true);
  },{passive:true,capture:true});

  window.addEventListener('pointerup',()=>setBoost(false),{passive:true,capture:true});
  window.addEventListener('pointercancel',()=>setBoost(false),{passive:true,capture:true});
  window.addEventListener('blur',()=>setBoost(false),{passive:true});

  window.addEventListener('scroll',()=>{
    isScrolling=true;
    document.body.classList.add('dgs-scroll-active');
    clearTimeout(scrollTimer);
    scrollTimer=setTimeout(()=>{
      isScrolling=false;
      document.body.classList.remove('dgs-scroll-active');
    },110);
  },{passive:true});

  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{
    hidden=document.hidden;
    if(!hidden){
      lastUpdate=performance.now();
      lastRender=0;
    }
  });
})();

    (function () {
      var pageSelector = '.dgs-performance-page';

      function setImportant(el, prop, value) {
        if (!el || !el.style) return;
        el.style.setProperty(prop, value, 'important');
      }

      function forceElementorParents(page) {
        if (!page) return;
        var node = page.parentElement;
        var limit = 0;

        while (node && node !== document.body && limit < 8) {
          var cls = node.className ? String(node.className) : '';

          if (
            cls.indexOf('elementor') !== -1 ||
            cls.indexOf('wp-block') !== -1 ||
            cls.indexOf('entry-content') !== -1 ||
            cls.indexOf('site-content') !== -1 ||
            cls.indexOf('content-area') !== -1
          ) {
            setImportant(node, 'max-width', 'none');
            setImportant(node, 'width', '100%');
            setImportant(node, 'padding-left', '0');
            setImportant(node, 'padding-right', '0');
            setImportant(node, 'margin-left', '0');
            setImportant(node, 'margin-right', '0');
            setImportant(node, 'overflow', 'visible');
          }

          node = node.parentElement;
          limit++;
        }
      }

      function forceFullWidth() {
        var page = document.querySelector(pageSelector);
        if (!page) return;

        forceElementorParents(page);

        if (window.innerWidth < 768) {
          setImportant(page, 'left', 'auto');

          setImportant(page, 'margin-right', '0');
        }

        setImportant(page, 'overflow-x', 'hidden');
        setImportant(page, 'transform', 'none');
      }

      function cleanDuplicatePages() {
        var pages = document.querySelectorAll(pageSelector);
        if (pages.length <= 1) return;

        pages.forEach(function (page, index) {
          if (index > 0 && page.parentNode) {
            page.parentNode.removeChild(page);

.dgs-page .dgs-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:12px 24px;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid var(--ln2);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
  font-family:var(--fm);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mu);margin-bottom:clamp(30px,4vw,46px)}

.dgs-page .dgs-hero-title .row>span{flex:0 0 auto;white-space:nowrap;word-break:keep-all;overflow-wrap:normal}
.dgs-page .row--moves{font-size:clamp(30px,8.8vw,128px)}
.dgs-page .row--city{font-size:clamp(26px,8.2vw,120px)}
.dgs-page .dgs-rot{display:inline-grid;vertical-align:baseline;font-style:italic;font-weight:600;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.dgs-page .dgs-rot>span{grid-area:1/1;white-space:nowrap;background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;animation:dgshift 5s linear infinite}

.dgs-page .ht-arrow{font-weight:500;font-style:normal;color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1.5px rgba(250,248,243,.85)}
.dgs-page .dgs-hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr;gap:clamp(28px,5vw,80px);align-items:end;margin-bottom:clamp(40px,5vw,66px)}

.dgs-page .dgs-hero-right{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:22px;align-items:flex-start}

.dgs-page .dgs-hero-cta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;margin-top:6px}
.dgs-page .dgs-hero-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);border-top:1px solid var(--ln);padding-top:clamp(26px,3vw,38px);gap:18px}

/* ---------- Marquee ---------- */

/* ---------- Clients ---------- */

@media(max-width:900px){.dgs-page .dgs-clients-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:560px){.dgs-page .dgs-clients-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}

/* ---------- Manifesto / scroll-fill text ---------- */
.dgs-page .dgs-fill{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(26px,3.6vw,50px);line-height:1.24;letter-spacing:-.02em;max-width:1150px;margin-bottom:26px}
.dgs-page .dgs-fill .w{opacity:.13}
.dgs-page .dgs-fill strong{font-weight:600;color:#fff}
.dgs-page .dgs-fill strong .w{opacity:1;background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
.dgs-page .dgs-mani-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.5fr 1fr;gap:clamp(36px,6vw,90px);align-items:start;margin-top:clamp(44px,6vw,80px)}

.dgs-page .dgs-inline:hover{border-bottom-color:var(--mg);box-shadow:inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(233,30,140,.4)}

  padding:clamp(24px,3vw,34px) 0;border-top:1px solid var(--ln);transition:padding .4s var(--ease)}

.dgs-page .dgs-steps .n{display:grid;place-items:center;width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--ln2);
  font-family:var(--fm);font-size:13px;color:var(--dim);transition:.4s var(--ease)}

/* ---------- Shared cards ---------- */
.dgs-page .dgs-grid3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px}

@media(max-width:680px){.dgs-page .dgs-grid3, .dgs-page .dgs-grid2{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.dgs-page .dgs-card{position:relative;padding:clamp(30px,3.2vw,42px);border:1px solid var(--ln);border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.035),rgba(255,255,255,.012));
  transition:transform .45s var(--ease),border-color .45s,box-shadow .45s;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.dgs-page .dgs-card:hover{transform:translateY(-8px);border-color:rgba(233,30,140,.42);box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(233,30,140,.14)}
.dgs-page .dgs-card::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:3px;background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s}

.dgs-page .dgs-card-num{position:absolute;top:26px;right:28px;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(48px,4.4vw,64px);line-height:1;
  color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(255,255,255,.14);transition:.45s var(--ease)}

.dgs-page .dgs-tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-family:var(--fm);font-size:10px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:18px}

.dgs-page .dgs-card-k{margin-top:auto;padding-top:26px}
.dgs-page .dgs-card-k i{display:block;border-top:1px solid var(--ln);padding-top:15px;font-style:normal;font-family:var(--fm);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);line-height:1.7}

.dgs-page .dgs-note{max-width:820px;margin-top:clamp(34px,4vw,52px);font-size:16px;line-height:1.85;color:var(--mu)}

/* ---------- Pillars — sticky stacked ---------- */
.dgs-page .dgs-stack{display:grid;gap:clamp(18px,2.4vw,26px)}
.dgs-page .dgs-stack-card{position:sticky;top:calc(96px + var(--i)*30px);border-radius:clamp(22px,2.4vw,30px);border:1px solid var(--ln2);overflow:hidden;

  padding:clamp(32px,4.6vw,68px);min-height:min(56vh,500px);will-change:transform;transform-origin:top center;isolation:isolate;
  box-shadow:0 -20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.45);transition:border-color .45s}

  color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1.5px rgba(250,248,243,.18);user-select:none}

.dgs-page .dgs-stack-body h3{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(26px,3.6vw,50px);line-height:1.02;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:0 0 16px;color:#fff}
.dgs-page .dgs-stack-body p{font-size:clamp(15px,1.25vw,17px);line-height:1.8;color:var(--mu);max-width:660px;margin-bottom:26px}

.dgs-page .dgs-case{border-radius:26px;border:1px solid var(--ln);background:var(--bg2);overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;position:relative;
  transition:transform .45s var(--ease),border-color .45s,box-shadow .45s}

.dgs-page .dgs-cn span{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim)}

/* ---------- Modals ---------- */

.dgs-page .dgs-mo-box{background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--ln2);border-radius:22px;max-width:660px;width:100%;max-height:88vh;overflow-y:auto;

.dgs-page .dgs-mo-ind{display:block;font-family:var(--fm);font-size:9.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:6px;
  background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
.dgs-page .dgs-mo-title{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-size:22px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em;color:#fff}
.dgs-page .dgs-mo-sub{display:block;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--dim);margin-top:3px}
.dgs-page .dgs-mo-b{padding:26px 28px 34px}
.dgs-page .dgs-mo-img{height:180px;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--ln);margin-bottom:24px}

.dgs-page .dgs-mo-s{margin-bottom:22px}
.dgs-page .dgs-mo-st{display:block;font-family:var(--fm);font-size:9.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:14px;padding-bottom:9px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ln);
  background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}

.dgs-page .dgs-mm{text-align:center;padding:16px;background:rgba(233,30,140,.06);border:1px solid var(--ln);border-radius:10px}
.dgs-page .dgs-mm strong{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-size:26px;font-weight:700;line-height:1;margin-bottom:5px;
  background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
.dgs-page .dgs-mm span{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim)}
.dgs-page .dgs-mlist{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.dgs-page .dgs-mlist li{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;padding:11px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);font-size:14.5px;color:var(--mu);line-height:1.6}

/* ---------- Awards ---------- */

/* ---------- Brand marquee ---------- */

/* ---------- Industry rows ---------- */
.dgs-page .dgs-irows{border-top:1px solid var(--ln);margin-top:clamp(40px,5vw,64px)}
.dgs-page .dgs-irow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:64px 1.1fr 1fr auto;gap:clamp(16px,3vw,40px);align-items:center;
  padding:clamp(24px,3vw,34px) 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ln);text-decoration:none;color:#fff;position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:background .4s}

.dgs-page .dgs-irow-m b{display:block;color:#fff;font-weight:600}
.dgs-page .dgs-irow-m::after{content:"↗";display:inline-block;margin-left:10px;font-size:16px;color:transparent;background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;transition:transform .4s var(--ease)}
.dgs-page .dgs-irow:hover .dgs-irow-m::after{transform:translate(5px,-5px)}
@media(max-width:860px){.dgs-page .dgs-irow{grid-template-columns:44px 1fr auto}.dgs-page .dgs-irow-d{display:none}}

/* ---------- Location cards ---------- */

  background:
  radial-gradient(70% 90% at 50% 120%,rgba(255,107,53,.13),transparent 60%),

    <p class="dgs-note" data-rv style="margin-top:0;margin-bottom:16px">The best SEO company for your business should explain <strong>what will be done, why it matters, and how progress will be measured</strong>.     <ol class="dgs-steps">
      <li data-rv><span class="n">01</span><span class="tx"><strong>Ask for a proper audit —</strong> technical health, content gaps, local signals, competitors, and tracking setup before any plan is suggested.</span></li>

  font-family:var(--fm);font-size:13px;color:var(--dim);transition:.4s var(--ease)}

/* ---------- Shared cards ---------- */

.dgs-page .dgs-card{position:relative;padding:clamp(30px,3.2vw,42px);border:1px solid var(--ln);border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;

  transition:transform .45s var(--ease),border-color .45s,box-shadow .45s;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.dgs-page .dgs-card:hover{transform:translateY(-8px);border-color:rgba(233,30,140,.42);box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(233,30,140,.14)}
.dgs-page .dgs-card::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:3px;background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s}
.dgs-page .dgs-card:hover::before{opacity:1}
.dgs-page .dgs-card-num{position:absolute;top:26px;right:28px;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(48px,4.4vw,64px);line-height:1;

.dgs-page .dgs-tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-family:var(--fm);font-size:10px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:18px}

.dgs-page .dgs-card-h{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(21px,1.9vw,25px);letter-spacing:-.01em;line-height:1.2;margin:0 0 12px;color:#fff;max-width:85%}
.dgs-page .dgs-card-p{font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.78;color:var(--mu)}

.dgs-page .dgs-card-k{margin-top:auto;padding-top:26px}
.dgs-page .dgs-card-k i{display:block;border-top:1px solid var(--ln);padding-top:15px;font-style:normal;font-family:var(--fm);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);line-height:1.7}
.dgs-page .dgs-card-k i b{color:#fff;font-weight:600}
.dgs-page .dgs-card-a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:20px;font-family:var(--fm);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff;text-decoration:none;width:fit-content}

.dgs-page .dgs-note{max-width:820px;margin-top:clamp(34px,4vw,52px);font-size:16px;line-height:1.85;color:var(--mu)}
.dgs-page .dgs-note strong{color:#fff;font-weight:600}
.dgs-page .dgs-note + .dgs-note{margin-top:16px}

/* ---------- Pillars — sticky stacked ---------- */
.dgs-page .dgs-stack{display:grid;gap:clamp(18px,2.4vw,26px)}
.dgs-page .dgs-stack-card{position:sticky;top:calc(96px + var(--i)*30px);border-radius:clamp(22px,2.4vw,30px);border:1px solid var(--ln2);overflow:hidden;

  padding:clamp(32px,4.6vw,68px);min-height:min(56vh,500px);will-change:transform;transform-origin:top center;isolation:isolate;
  box-shadow:0 -20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.45);transition:border-color .45s}

.dgs-page .dgs-stack-body h3{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(26px,3.6vw,50px);line-height:1.02;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:0 0 16px;color:#fff}
.dgs-page .dgs-stack-body p{font-size:clamp(15px,1.25vw,17px);line-height:1.8;color:var(--mu);max-width:660px;margin-bottom:26px}
.dgs-page .dgs-stack-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.dgs-page .dgs-stack-chips span{padding:11px 18px;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid var(--ln);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);

/* ---------- Case studies ---------- */

.dgs-page .dgs-case{border-radius:26px;border:1px solid var(--ln);background:var(--bg2);overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;position:relative;
  transition:transform .45s var(--ease),border-color .45s,box-shadow .45s}

.dgs-page .dgs-cn span{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim)}

(function () {
  "use strict";

  var root = document.querySelector("#client-case-studies");
  if (!root) return;

  var isElementorEditor =
    document.body.classList.contains("elementor-editor-active") ||
    window.location.href.indexOf("elementor-preview") !== -1;

  if (isElementorEditor) return;

  function lockScroll() {
    document.documentElement.classList.add("dgs-modal-open");
    document.body.classList.add("dgs-modal-open");
  }

  function unlockScroll() {
    if (!root.querySelector(".modal.on")) {
      document.documentElement.classList.remove("dgs-modal-open");
      document.body.classList.remove("dgs-modal-open");
    }
  }

  root.querySelectorAll("[data-case-modal]").forEach(function (card) {
    function openCaseModal() {
      var modalKey = card.getAttribute("data-case-modal");
      var modal = root.querySelector("#case-modal-" + modalKey);
      if (!modal) return;

      modal.classList.add("on");
      modal.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
      lockScroll();
    }

    card.addEventListener("click", openCaseModal);

    card.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
      if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
        event.preventDefault();
        openCaseModal();
      }
    });
  });

  root.querySelectorAll(".modal").forEach(function (modal) {
    var closeButton = modal.querySelector(".mx");

    function closeModal() {
      modal.classList.remove("on");
      modal.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      unlockScroll();
    }

    if (closeButton) {
      closeButton.addEventListener("click", closeModal);
    }

    modal.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
      if (event.target === modal) closeModal();
    });
  });

  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
    if (event.key !== "Escape") return;

    root.querySelectorAll(".modal.on").forEach(function (modal) {
      modal.classList.remove("on");
      modal.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    });

    unlockScroll();
  });
})();
</script>

<!-- TECHNICAL AUDIT -->
<section class="dgs-sec dgs-sec--line" id="technical-seo-audit">
  <div class="dgs-wrap">
    <div class="dgs-head">
      <div>
        <div class="dgs-eyebrow" data-rv>(09) — <em>Crawling & ranking foundation</em></div>
        <h2 class="dgs-h2" data-rv-lines>Technical SEO audit for <span class="gt">better crawling</span> & indexing</h2>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="dgs-grid3">
      <article class="dgs-card" data-rv>
        <span class="dgs-card-num">01</span>
        <span class="dgs-tag">Crawl</span>
        <h3 class="dgs-card-h">Crawl checks</h3>
        <p class="dgs-card-p">robots.txt, XML sitemap, blocked pages, broken links, redirect chains, orphan pages — and how easily search engines move through the site.</p>
      </article>
      <article class="dgs-card" data-rv>
        <span class="dgs-card-num">02</span>
        <span class="dgs-tag">Index</span>
        <h3 class="dgs-card-h">Indexing checks</h3>
        <p class="dgs-card-p">noindex tags, canonical issues, duplicate URLs, thin pages, soft 404s, and Search Console coverage problems that stop pages appearing in Google.</p>
      </article>
      <article class="dgs-card" data-rv>
        <span class="dgs-card-num">03</span>
        <span class="dgs-tag">Quality</span>
        <h3 class="dgs-card-h">Page quality checks</h3>
        <p class="dgs-card-p">Titles, descriptions, headings, schema, image alt text, mobile experience, speed, internal links, and page-level content clarity.</p>
      </article>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

(function () {

  if (isElementorEditor) return;

  function lockScroll() {
    document.documentElement.classList.add("dgs-modal-open");
    document.body.classList.add("dgs-modal-open");
  }

  function unlockScroll() {
    if (!root.querySelector(".modal.on")) {
      document.documentElement.classList.remove("dgs-modal-open");
      document.body.classList.remove("dgs-modal-open");
    }
  }

  root.querySelectorAll("[data-case-modal]").forEach(function (card) {
    function openCaseModal() {
      var modalKey = card.getAttribute("data-case-modal");
      var modal = root.querySelector("#case-modal-" + modalKey);
      if (!modal) return;

      modal.classList.add("on");
      modal.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
      lockScroll();
    }

    card.addEventListener("click", openCaseModal);

    card.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
      if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
        event.preventDefault();
        openCaseModal();
      }
    });
  });

  root.querySelectorAll(".modal").forEach(function (modal) {
    var closeButton = modal.querySelector(".mx");

    function closeModal() {
      modal.classList.remove("on");
      modal.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      unlockScroll();
    }

    if (closeButton) {
      closeButton.addEventListener("click", closeModal);
    }

    modal.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
      if (event.target === modal) closeModal();
    });
  });

  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
    if (event.key !== "Escape") return;

    root.querySelectorAll(".modal.on").forEach(function (modal) {
      modal.classList.remove("on");
      modal.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    });

    unlockScroll();
  });
})();

<!-- HOW TO CHOOSE -->
<section class="dgs-sec dgs-sec--line" id="how-to-choose">
  <div class="dgs-wrap dgs-wrap--s">
    <div class="dgs-eyebrow" data-rv>(10) — <em>Buyer's guide</em></div>
    <h2 class="dgs-h2" data-rv-lines style="margin-bottom:28px">How to choose the <span class="gt">best SEO company</span> in Bangalore</h2>
    <p class="dgs-note" data-rv style="margin-top:0;margin-bottom:16px">The best SEO company for your business should explain <strong>what will be done, why it matters, and how progress will be measured</strong>. Before choosing an SEO agency in India or a team serving Bangalore, check whether they understand your industry, competitors, website issues, target locations, and the type of leads you want.</p>
    <p class="dgs-note" data-rv style="margin-top:0">Serious SEO services for business growth connect technical improvements, content, authority, local visibility, and conversion tracking. Generic providers focus on activity volume without explaining how that work supports enquiries or revenue.</p>
    <ol class="dgs-steps">
      <li data-rv><span class="n">01</span><span class="tx"><strong>Ask for a proper audit —</strong> technical health, content gaps, local signals, competitors, and tracking setup before any plan is suggested.</span></li>
      <li data-rv><span class="n">02</span><span class="tx"><strong>Check how they explain strategy —</strong> if the explanation is only backlinks and keywords, the plan is incomplete.</span></li>
      <li data-rv><span class="n">03</span><span class="tx"><strong>Look for useful proof —</strong> case studies, Search Console growth, ranking movement, and lead improvements beat vague promises.</span></li>
      <li data-rv><span class="n">04</span><span class="tx"><strong>Understand the reporting —</strong> you should know what improved, what is pending, and what actions are planned next.</span></li>
      <li data-rv><span class="n">05</span><span class="tx"><strong>Avoid guaranteed ranking claims —</strong> serious SEO depends on competition, website quality, content, technical health, and time.</span></li>
    </ol>
  </div>
</section>
