/* film grain overlay */
.dgs-page .dgs-grain{position:fixed;inset:-60%;width:220%;height:220%;z-index:3;pointer-events:none;opacity:.05;
  background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='220' height='220'><filter id='n'><feTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.85' numOctaves='2' stitchTiles='stitch'/><feColorMatrix type='saturate' values='0'/></filter><rect width='220' height='220' filter='url(%23n)' opacity='0.6'/></svg>");
  animation:dgrain 9s steps(10) infinite}
.dgs-page .dgs-orb{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(130px);opacity:.16;pointer-events:none;will-change:transform;z-index:1}

/* ---------- Custom cursor ---------- */
.dgs-page .dgs-cur, .dgs-page .dgs-cur2{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:99999;border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);display:none}
.dgs-page .dgs-cur{width:8px;height:8px;background:#fff;mix-blend-mode:difference}
.dgs-page .dgs-cur2{width:40px;height:40px;border:1px solid rgba(250,248,243,.4);transition:width .35s var(--ease),height .35s var(--ease),background .35s,border-color .35s}
.dgs-page .dgs-cur2.hov{width:74px;height:74px;background:rgba(233,30,140,.14);border-color:rgba(233,30,140,.65)}
body.dgs-has-cur .dgs-page .dgs-cur, body.dgs-has-cur .dgs-page .dgs-cur2{display:block}
@media(pointer:coarse){.dgs-page .dgs-cur, .dgs-page .dgs-cur2{display:none!important}}

/* ---------- Type system ---------- */
.dgs-page .dgs-eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;font-family:var(--fm);font-size:11px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:28px}
.dgs-page .dgs-eyebrow::before{content:"";width:38px;height:1px;background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%}
.dgs-page .dgs-eyebrow em{font-style:normal;color:#fff}
.dgs-page .dgs-h2{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(40px,6.2vw,88px);line-height:.98;letter-spacing:-.03em;margin:0 0 0;color:#fff}
.dgs-page .dgs-h3{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(26px,3vw,38px);line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:44px 0 18px;color:#fff}
.dgs-page .dgs-sub{font-size:clamp(15.5px,1.3vw,17.5px);line-height:1.85;color:var(--mu);max-width:560px}
.dgs-page .dgs-head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.35fr .85fr;gap:clamp(28px,5vw,72px);align-items:end;margin-bottom:clamp(48px,6.5vw,92px)}
.dgs-page .dgs-head--c{grid-template-columns:1fr;text-align:center;justify-items:center}
.dgs-page .dgs-head--c .dgs-eyebrow{justify-content:center}
@media(max-width:900px){.dgs-page .dgs-head{grid-template-columns:1fr;align-items:start}}
.dgs-page .rl{display:block;overflow:hidden;padding-bottom:.08em;margin-bottom:-.08em}
.dgs-page .rl-i{display:block;will-change:transform}

/* ---------- Buttons & chips ---------- */
.dgs-page .dgs-btn{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:19px 32px;border-radius:999px;
  font-family:var(--fb);font-weight:600;font-size:15.5px;letter-spacing:.01em;color:#fff!important;text-decoration:none!important;
  border:1px solid var(--ln2);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;
  transition:transform .4s var(--ease),box-shadow .4s,background .4s,border-color .4s;will-change:transform}
.dgs-page .dgs-btn svg{width:15px;height:15px;flex-shrink:0;transition:transform .4s var(--ease)}
.dgs-page .dgs-btn:hover svg{transform:translate(3px,-3px)}
.dgs-page .dgs-btn--fill{background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;animation:dgshift 6s linear infinite;border-color:transparent;box-shadow:0 12px 38px rgba(233,30,140,.32)}
.dgs-page .dgs-btn--fill:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 18px 52px rgba(233,30,140,.48)}
.dgs-page .dgs-btn--ghost{backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}
.dgs-page .dgs-btn--ghost:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);border-color:rgba(233,30,140,.55)}
.dgs-page .dgs-btn--wa:hover{border-color:var(--wa);background:rgba(37,211,102,.12)}
.dgs-page .dgs-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.dgs-page .dgs-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:10px 18px;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid var(--ln);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);font-family:var(--fm);font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mu);white-space:nowrap}
.dgs-page .dgs-chip::before{content:"";width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--grad)}

/* ---------- HERO ---------- */
.dgs-page .dgs-hero{position:relative;min-height:100svh;display:flex;align-items:center;overflow:hidden;padding:clamp(120px,14vh,170px) 0 clamp(70px,8vh,110px);background:#000}
.dgs-page .dgs-hero::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;
  background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.033) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.033) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:76px 76px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(62% 60% at 50% 42%,#000 30%,transparent 100%);
  mask-image:radial-gradient(62% 60% at 50% 42%,#000 30%,transparent 100%)}
.dgs-page .dgs-hero-orb1{width:640px;height:640px;background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--mg),transparent 70%);top:-200px;left:-180px;animation:dfloat 26s ease-in-out infinite}
.dgs-page .dgs-hero-orb2{width:520px;height:520px;background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--pu),transparent 70%);top:34%;right:-190px;animation:dfloat 32s ease-in-out infinite 6s}
.dgs-page .dgs-hero-orb3{width:720px;height:720px;background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--or),transparent 70%);bottom:-300px;left:32%;animation:dfloat 38s ease-in-out infinite 12s;opacity:.12}
.dgs-page .dgs-hero-meta{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-family:var(--fm);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:clamp(34px,5vw,60px)}
.dgs-page .dgs-hero-meta b{color:var(--wh);font-weight:500}
.dgs-page .dgs-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:12px 24px;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid var(--ln2);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
  font-family:var(--fm);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mu);margin-bottom:clamp(30px,4vw,46px)}
.dgs-page .dgs-badge i{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gn);animation:dpulse 2.2s ease-in-out infinite}
.dgs-page .dgs-hero-title{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(52px,10.6vw,158px);line-height:.96;letter-spacing:-.035em;margin:0 0 clamp(30px,4vw,48px);text-transform:uppercase}
.dgs-page .dgs-hero-title .row{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:.18em;flex-wrap:nowrap;white-space:nowrap;word-break:keep-all;overflow-wrap:normal}
.dgs-page .dgs-hero-title .row>span{flex:0 0 auto;white-space:nowrap;word-break:keep-all;overflow-wrap:normal}
.dgs-page .row--moves{font-size:clamp(30px,8.8vw,128px)}
.dgs-page .row--city{font-size:clamp(26px,8.2vw,120px)}
.dgs-page .dgs-rot{display:inline-grid;vertical-align:baseline;font-style:italic;font-weight:600;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.dgs-page .dgs-rot>span{grid-area:1/1;white-space:nowrap;background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;animation:dgshift 5s linear infinite}
.dgs-page .dgs-rot>span:not(:first-child){opacity:0}
.dgs-page .ht-arrow{font-weight:500;font-style:normal;color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1.5px rgba(250,248,243,.85)}
.dgs-page .dgs-hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr;gap:clamp(28px,5vw,80px);align-items:end;margin-bottom:clamp(40px,5vw,66px)}
.dgs-page .dgs-hero-desc{font-size:clamp(15.5px,1.35vw,18px);line-height:1.85;color:var(--mu);max-width:600px}
.dgs-page .dgs-hero-desc strong{color:#fff;font-weight:600}
.dgs-page .dgs-hero-right{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:22px;align-items:flex-start}
.dgs-page .dgs-updated{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.06em;line-height:1.9;color:var(--dim);max-width:420px}
.dgs-page .dgs-updated b{color:var(--wh);font-weight:600;display:block;letter-spacing:.28em;margin-bottom:6px}
.dgs-page .dgs-hero-cta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;margin-top:6px}
.dgs-page .dgs-hero-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);border-top:1px solid var(--ln);padding-top:clamp(26px,3vw,38px);gap:18px}
.dgs-page .dgs-stat strong{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(26px,2.8vw,42px);letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1;margin-bottom:8px}
.dgs-page .dgs-stat span{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim)}
.dgs-page .dgs-cue{position:absolute;right:clamp(22px,4vw,54px);bottom:clamp(24px,4vw,44px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:12px;z-index:2}
.dgs-page .dgs-cue span{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.34em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);writing-mode:vertical-rl}
.dgs-page .dgs-cue i{width:1px;height:56px;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,var(--mg),transparent);animation:dcue 2.2s var(--ease) infinite}
@media(max-width:900px){
  .dgs-page .dgs-hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;align-items:start}
  .dgs-page .dgs-hero-stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);row-gap:26px}
  .dgs-page .dgs-cue{display:none}
}

/* ---------- Marquee ---------- */
.dgs-page .dgs-mq{overflow:hidden;width:100%;border-block:1px solid var(--ln);padding:clamp(22px,3.4vw,38px) 0;background:#000;position:relative;z-index:2}
.dgs-page .dgs-mq-track{display:flex;width:max-content;animation:dmq 48s linear infinite;will-change:transform;backface-visibility:hidden}
.dgs-page .dgs-mq:hover .dgs-mq-track{animation-play-state:paused}
.dgs-page .dgs-mq-half{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-shrink:0}
.dgs-page .dgs-mq-item{display:flex;align-items:center;padding:.14em clamp(40px,5vw,84px) .14em 0;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(30px,4.4vw,64px);line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.02em;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap}
.dgs-page .dgs-mq-item.alt{color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(250,248,243,.55)}
.dgs-page .dgs-mq-item em{font-style:normal;margin:0 clamp(14px,1.6vw,26px);font-size:.48em;line-height:0;background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:0;animation:dgshift 5s linear infinite}

/* ---------- Clients ---------- */
.dgs-page .dgs-clients{padding:clamp(56px,7vw,88px) 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ln);background:var(--bg);position:relative;z-index:2}
.dgs-page .dgs-clients-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:clamp(26px,4vw,54px);align-items:center}
.dgs-page .dgs-client{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;opacity:.6;filter:grayscale(1) brightness(1.6);transition:.4s var(--ease)}
.dgs-page .dgs-client:hover{opacity:1;filter:none;transform:translateY(-4px)}
.dgs-page .dgs-client img{max-width:120px;height:auto;max-height:44px;object-fit:contain}
@media(max-width:900px){.dgs-page .dgs-clients-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:560px){.dgs-page .dgs-clients-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}

/* ---------- Manifesto / scroll-fill text ---------- */
.dgs-page .dgs-fill{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(26px,3.6vw,50px);line-height:1.24;letter-spacing:-.02em;max-width:1150px;margin-bottom:26px}
.dgs-page .dgs-fill .w{opacity:.13}
.dgs-page .dgs-fill strong{font-weight:600;color:#fff}
.dgs-page .dgs-fill strong .w{opacity:1;background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
.dgs-page .dgs-mani-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.5fr 1fr;gap:clamp(36px,6vw,90px);align-items:start;margin-top:clamp(44px,6vw,80px)}
@media(max-width:900px){.dgs-page .dgs-mani-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.dgs-page .dgs-mani-side p{font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.85;color:var(--mu);margin-bottom:18px}
.dgs-page .dgs-mani-side strong{color:#fff;font-weight:600}
.dgs-page .dgs-inline{color:#fff;text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);transition:.25s}
.dgs-page .dgs-inline:hover{border-bottom-color:var(--mg);box-shadow:inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(233,30,140,.4)}

/* ---------- Numbered steps ---------- */
.dgs-page .dgs-steps{list-style:none;margin:34px 0 0;padding:0;counter-reset:dstep}
.dgs-page .dgs-steps li{counter-increment:dstep;display:grid;grid-template-columns:72px 1fr;gap:clamp(18px,3vw,34px);align-items:start;
  padding:clamp(24px,3vw,34px) 0;border-top:1px solid var(--ln);transition:padding .4s var(--ease)}
.dgs-page .dgs-steps li:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid var(--ln)}
.dgs-page .dgs-steps li:hover{padding-left:14px}
.dgs-page .dgs-steps .n{display:grid;place-items:center;width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--ln2);
  font-family:var(--fm);font-size:13px;color:var(--dim);transition:.4s var(--ease)}
.dgs-page .dgs-steps li:hover .n{background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;border-color:transparent;color:#fff}
.dgs-page .dgs-steps .tx{font-size:clamp(15.5px,1.3vw,18px);line-height:1.8;color:var(--mu);padding-top:12px}
.dgs-page .dgs-steps .tx strong{color:#fff;font-weight:600}

/* ---------- Shared cards ---------- */
.dgs-page .dgs-grid3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px}
.dgs-page .dgs-grid2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:18px}
@media(max-width:1024px){.dgs-page .dgs-grid3{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:680px){.dgs-page .dgs-grid3, .dgs-page .dgs-grid2{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.dgs-page .dgs-card{position:relative;padding:clamp(30px,3.2vw,42px);border:1px solid var(--ln);border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.035),rgba(255,255,255,.012));
  transition:transform .45s var(--ease),border-color .45s,box-shadow .45s;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.dgs-page .dgs-card:hover{transform:translateY(-8px);border-color:rgba(233,30,140,.42);box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(233,30,140,.14)}
.dgs-page .dgs-card::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:3px;background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s}
.dgs-page .dgs-card:hover::before{opacity:1}
.dgs-page .dgs-card-num{position:absolute;top:26px;right:28px;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(48px,4.4vw,64px);line-height:1;
  color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(255,255,255,.14);transition:.45s var(--ease)}
.dgs-page .dgs-card:hover .dgs-card-num{-webkit-text-stroke-color:rgba(233,30,140,.5)}
.dgs-page .dgs-tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-family:var(--fm);font-size:10px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:18px}
.dgs-page .dgs-tag::before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--grad)}
.dgs-page .dgs-card-h{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(21px,1.9vw,25px);letter-spacing:-.01em;line-height:1.2;margin:0 0 12px;color:#fff;max-width:85%}
.dgs-page .dgs-card-p{font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.78;color:var(--mu)}
.dgs-page .dgs-card-p strong{color:#fff;font-weight:600}
.dgs-page .dgs-card-k{margin-top:auto;padding-top:26px}
.dgs-page .dgs-card-k i{display:block;border-top:1px solid var(--ln);padding-top:15px;font-style:normal;font-family:var(--fm);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);line-height:1.7}
.dgs-page .dgs-card-k i b{color:#fff;font-weight:600}
.dgs-page .dgs-card-a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:20px;font-family:var(--fm);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff;text-decoration:none;width:fit-content}
.dgs-page .dgs-card-a::after{content:"↗";color:transparent;background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;font-size:15px;transition:transform .35s var(--ease)}
.dgs-page .dgs-card-a:hover::after{transform:translate(4px,-4px)}
.dgs-page .dgs-note{max-width:820px;margin-top:clamp(34px,4vw,52px);font-size:16px;line-height:1.85;color:var(--mu)}
.dgs-page .dgs-note strong{color:#fff;font-weight:600}
.dgs-page .dgs-note + .dgs-note{margin-top:16px}

/* ---------- Pillars — sticky stacked ---------- */
.dgs-page .dgs-stack{display:grid;gap:clamp(18px,2.4vw,26px)}
.dgs-page .dgs-stack-card{position:sticky;top:calc(96px + var(--i)*30px);border-radius:clamp(22px,2.4vw,30px);border:1px solid var(--ln2);overflow:hidden;
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:clamp(26px,4.5vw,72px);align-items:center;
  padding:clamp(32px,4.6vw,68px);min-height:min(56vh,500px);will-change:transform;transform-origin:top center;isolation:isolate;
  box-shadow:0 -20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.45);transition:border-color .45s}
.dgs-page .dgs-stack-card:nth-child(1){--i:0;z-index:1;background:radial-gradient(120% 160% at 100% 0%,rgba(233,30,140,.16),transparent 55%),#0B0A12}
.dgs-page .dgs-stack-card:nth-child(2){--i:1;z-index:2;background:radial-gradient(120% 160% at 0% 100%,rgba(185,30,140,.16),transparent 55%),#0D0B14}
.dgs-page .dgs-stack-card:nth-child(3){--i:2;z-index:3;background:radial-gradient(120% 160% at 100% 100%,rgba(255,107,53,.14),transparent 55%),#0F0C15}
.dgs-page .dgs-stack-idx{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(80px,12vw,190px);line-height:.85;letter-spacing:-.05em;
  color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1.5px rgba(250,248,243,.18);user-select:none}
.dgs-page .dgs-stack-body .dgs-tag{margin-bottom:16px}
.dgs-page .dgs-stack-body h3{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(26px,3.6vw,50px);line-height:1.02;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:0 0 16px;color:#fff}
.dgs-page .dgs-stack-body p{font-size:clamp(15px,1.25vw,17px);line-height:1.8;color:var(--mu);max-width:660px;margin-bottom:26px}
.dgs-page .dgs-stack-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.dgs-page .dgs-stack-chips span{padding:11px 18px;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid var(--ln);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);
  font-size:13px;color:var(--mu);transition:.3s}
.dgs-page .dgs-stack-chips span:hover{border-color:rgba(233,30,140,.5);color:#fff;transform:translateY(-2px)}
@media(max-width:860px){
  .dgs-page .dgs-stack{gap:18px}
  .dgs-page .dgs-stack-card{position:relative;top:auto;grid-template-columns:1fr;min-height:auto;gap:20px;transform:none!important;box-shadow:none}
  .dgs-page .dgs-stack-idx{font-size:clamp(60px,15vw,104px)}
}

/* ---------- Case studies ---------- */
.dgs-page .dgs-case-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(18px,2.6vw,30px)}
@media(max-width:860px){.dgs-page .dgs-case-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.dgs-page .dgs-case{border-radius:26px;border:1px solid var(--ln);background:var(--bg2);overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;position:relative;
  transition:transform .45s var(--ease),border-color .45s,box-shadow .45s}
.dgs-page .dgs-case::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;z-index:2}
.dgs-page .dgs-case:hover{transform:translateY(-8px);border-color:var(--ln2);box-shadow:0 32px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.55)}
.dgs-page .dgs-case:focus-visible{outline:2px solid rgba(233,30,140,.6);outline-offset:4px}
.dgs-page .dgs-case-shot{height:clamp(200px,24vw,320px);overflow:hidden;position:relative}
.dgs-page .dgs-case-shot::after{content:"";position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:70px;background:linear-gradient(to top,var(--bg2),transparent)}
.dgs-page .dgs-case-shot img{width:100%;height:112%;object-fit:cover;object-position:top;will-change:transform}
.dgs-page .dgs-case-body{padding:clamp(24px,3vw,34px)}
.dgs-page .dgs-case-logo{height:28px;margin-bottom:16px}
.dgs-page .dgs-case-logo img{height:100%;width:auto;object-fit:contain}
.dgs-page .dgs-case-tag{display:inline-block;padding:6px 14px;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(233,30,140,.1);border:1px solid rgba(233,30,140,.25);
  font-family:var(--fm);font-size:9.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#ff7ec2;margin-bottom:16px}
.dgs-page .dgs-case-body h3{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(22px,2.2vw,28px);letter-spacing:-.015em;margin:0 0 10px;color:#fff}
.dgs-page .dgs-case-body>p{font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.75;color:var(--mu);margin-bottom:24px}
.dgs-page .dgs-case-nums{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:9px;margin-bottom:20px}
.dgs-page .dgs-cn{text-align:center;padding:15px 6px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border:1px solid var(--ln);border-radius:12px}
.dgs-page .dgs-cn strong{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(20px,2vw,26px);line-height:1;margin-bottom:6px;
  background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;animation:dgshift 6s linear infinite}
.dgs-page .dgs-cn span{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim)}
.dgs-page .dgs-case-view{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-family:var(--fm);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;
  background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;animation:dgshift 6s linear infinite}
.dgs-page .dgs-case-view::after{content:"→";-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;transition:transform .35s var(--ease)}
.dgs-page .dgs-case:hover .dgs-case-view::after{transform:translateX(5px)}
.dgs-page .dgs-case-ft{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:16px clamp(24px,3vw,34px);border-top:1px solid var(--ln)}
.dgs-page .dgs-case-av{display:grid;place-items:center;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:10px;flex-shrink:0;
  background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;font-family:var(--fd);font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:#fff}
.dgs-page .dgs-case-fn{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mu)}
.dgs-page .dgs-case-fm{margin-left:auto;font-family:var(--fm);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim)}

/* ---------- Proof bento ---------- */
.dgs-page .dgs-bento{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px}
@media(max-width:1024px){.dgs-page .dgs-bento{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:640px){.dgs-page .dgs-bento{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.dgs-page .dgs-bi{position:relative;border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--ln);background:var(--bg2);aspect-ratio:4/3.2;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .4s var(--ease),border-color .4s}
.dgs-page .dgs-bi:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);border-color:var(--ln2)}
.dgs-page .dgs-bi img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .7s var(--ease)}
.dgs-page .dgs-bi:hover img{transform:scale(1.05)}
.dgs-page .dgs-bio{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;padding:16px 18px;background:linear-gradient(to top,rgba(5,5,7,.95) 20%,transparent);z-index:2}
.dgs-page .dgs-bipill{display:inline-block;padding:4px 11px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;color:#fff;
  font-family:var(--fm);font-size:9px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:7px}
.dgs-page .dgs-bittl{font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:#fff}
.dgs-page .dgs-bizoom{position:absolute;top:12px;right:12px;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:9px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);border:1px solid var(--ln2);
  display:grid;place-items:center;opacity:0;transition:.25s;z-index:2}
.dgs-page .dgs-bi:hover .dgs-bizoom{opacity:1}
.dgs-page .dgs-bizoom svg{width:13px;height:13px;stroke:#fff;stroke-width:2;fill:none}

/* ---------- Lightbox ---------- */
.dgs-page .dgs-lb{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:900000;background:rgba(3,3,6,.96);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .35s,visibility .35s}
.dgs-page .dgs-lb.on{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
.dgs-page .dgs-lbtop{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;padding:16px 22px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ln);background:rgba(10,10,16,.9)}
.dgs-page .dgs-lbtl{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;min-width:0}
.dgs-page .dgs-lbpill{padding:5px 12px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;color:#fff;font-family:var(--fm);font-size:9px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap}
.dgs-page .dgs-lbttl{font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:#fff;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.dgs-page .dgs-lbcount{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:11px;color:var(--dim);margin-right:6px;white-space:nowrap}
.dgs-page .dgs-lbactions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.dgs-page .dgs-lbtn{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid var(--ln2);color:var(--mu);
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;font-size:17px;transition:.25s;font-family:var(--fb)}
.dgs-page .dgs-lbtn:hover{color:#fff;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);background:rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
.dgs-page .dgs-lbbody{flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:26px;overflow:hidden}
.dgs-page .dgs-lbimg{max-width:min(1200px,92vw);max-height:calc(100vh - 130px);width:auto;height:auto;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid var(--ln2);box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.6);object-fit:contain}

/* ---------- Modals ---------- */
.dgs-page .dgs-mo{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:800000;background:rgba(3,3,6,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:22px;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .3s,visibility .3s}
.dgs-page .dgs-mo.on{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
.dgs-page .dgs-mo-box{background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--ln2);border-radius:22px;max-width:660px;width:100%;max-height:88vh;overflow-y:auto;
  position:relative;box-shadow:0 48px 120px rgba(0,0,0,.8);transform:translateY(22px) scale(.97);transition:transform .45s var(--ease)}
.dgs-page .dgs-mo.on .dgs-mo-box{transform:none}
.dgs-page .dgs-mo-box::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;border-radius:22px 22px 0 0;animation:dgshift 6s linear infinite;z-index:3}
.dgs-page .dgs-mo-h{padding:26px 62px 22px 28px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ln);position:sticky;top:0;background:rgba(18,18,26,.97);z-index:2}
.dgs-page .dgs-mo-x{position:absolute;top:14px;right:14px;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid var(--ln2);
  display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer;font-size:16px;color:var(--mu);transition:.25s;font-family:var(--fb)}
.dgs-page .dgs-mo-x:hover{color:#fff;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
.dgs-page .dgs-mo-ind{display:block;font-family:var(--fm);font-size:9.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:6px;
  background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
.dgs-page .dgs-mo-title{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-size:22px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em;color:#fff}
.dgs-page .dgs-mo-sub{display:block;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--dim);margin-top:3px}
.dgs-page .dgs-mo-b{padding:26px 28px 34px}
.dgs-page .dgs-mo-img{height:180px;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--ln);margin-bottom:24px}
.dgs-page .dgs-mo-img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:top}
.dgs-page .dgs-mo-s{margin-bottom:22px}
.dgs-page .dgs-mo-st{display:block;font-family:var(--fm);font-size:9.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:14px;padding-bottom:9px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ln);
  background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
.dgs-page .dgs-mo-met{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:10px}
.dgs-page .dgs-mm{text-align:center;padding:16px;background:rgba(233,30,140,.06);border:1px solid var(--ln);border-radius:10px}
.dgs-page .dgs-mm strong{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-size:26px;font-weight:700;line-height:1;margin-bottom:5px;
  background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
.dgs-page .dgs-mm span{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim)}
.dgs-page .dgs-mlist{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.dgs-page .dgs-mlist li{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;padding:11px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);font-size:14.5px;color:var(--mu);line-height:1.6}
.dgs-page .dgs-mlist li:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.dgs-page .dgs-mlc{width:19px;height:19px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:2px;background:rgba(34,197,94,.1);border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,.25);
  display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:9px;color:var(--gn)}
.dgs-page .dgs-mdesc{font-size:14px;color:var(--mu);line-height:1.8;padding:16px 18px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border-radius:10px;border-left:2px solid rgba(233,30,140,.55)}

/* ---------- Awards ---------- */
.dgs-page .dgs-award-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px}
@media(max-width:1024px){.dgs-page .dgs-award-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:680px){.dgs-page .dgs-award-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.dgs-page .dgs-award{border:1px solid var(--ln);border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.03),rgba(255,255,255,.01));
  position:relative;transition:transform .45s var(--ease),border-color .45s,box-shadow .45s}
.dgs-page .dgs-award::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;z-index:2}
.dgs-page .dgs-award:hover{transform:translateY(-8px);border-color:rgba(233,30,140,.4);box-shadow:0 28px 70px rgba(233,30,140,.14)}
.dgs-page .dgs-award-img{height:clamp(280px,30vw,390px);padding:14px 14px 0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.dgs-page .dgs-award-img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain}
.dgs-page .dgs-award-body{padding:26px 26px 30px;border-top:1px solid var(--ln)}
.dgs-page .dgs-award-tag{display:inline-block;padding:5px 13px;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(233,30,140,.09);border:1px solid rgba(233,30,140,.24);
  font-family:var(--fm);font-size:9px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mu);margin-bottom:14px}
.dgs-page .dgs-award-title{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:19px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:-.01em;color:#fff;margin:0 0 9px}
.dgs-page .dgs-award-desc{font-size:14px;line-height:1.75;color:var(--mu)}

/* ---------- Brand marquee ---------- */
.dgs-page .dgs-brands{padding:clamp(64px,8vw,110px) 0;border-block:1px solid var(--ln);background:#000;position:relative;z-index:2}
.dgs-page .dgs-bmq{position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:10px 0;margin-top:clamp(36px,5vw,56px);
  -webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(to right,transparent,#000 10%,#000 90%,transparent);
  mask-image:linear-gradient(to right,transparent,#000 10%,#000 90%,transparent)}
.dgs-page .dgs-bmq-track{display:flex;width:max-content;animation:dmq 90s linear infinite;will-change:transform;backface-visibility:hidden}
.dgs-page .dgs-bmq-half{display:flex;gap:12px;padding-right:12px;flex-shrink:0}
.dgs-page .dgs-bmq-track:hover{animation-play-state:paused}
.dgs-page .dgs-nc{flex-shrink:0;width:168px;height:74px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--ln);background:rgba(255,255,255,.02);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:10px 14px;transition:.3s}
.dgs-page .dgs-nc:hover{border-color:rgba(233,30,140,.3);background:rgba(233,30,140,.05);transform:translateY(-3px)}
.dgs-page .dgs-nc img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;opacity:.72;filter:brightness(.85) saturate(.6);transition:.3s}
.dgs-page .dgs-nc:hover img{opacity:1;filter:none}

/* ---------- Industry rows ---------- */
.dgs-page .dgs-irows{border-top:1px solid var(--ln);margin-top:clamp(40px,5vw,64px)}
.dgs-page .dgs-irow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:64px 1.1fr 1fr auto;gap:clamp(16px,3vw,40px);align-items:center;
  padding:clamp(24px,3vw,34px) 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ln);text-decoration:none;color:#fff;position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:background .4s}
.dgs-page .dgs-irow::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(233,30,140,.09),rgba(255,107,53,.05));opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s}
.dgs-page .dgs-irow:hover::before{opacity:1}
.dgs-page .dgs-irow>*{position:relative;z-index:1}
.dgs-page .dgs-irow-n{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:12px;color:var(--dim);letter-spacing:.1em}
.dgs-page .dgs-irow-t{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(22px,2.6vw,34px);letter-spacing:-.02em;transition:transform .45s var(--ease)}
.dgs-page .dgs-irow:hover .dgs-irow-t{transform:translateX(12px);background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
.dgs-page .dgs-irow-d{font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--dim)}
.dgs-page .dgs-irow-m{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mu);text-align:right;line-height:1.8}
.dgs-page .dgs-irow-m b{display:block;color:#fff;font-weight:600}
.dgs-page .dgs-irow-m::after{content:"↗";display:inline-block;margin-left:10px;font-size:16px;color:transparent;background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;transition:transform .4s var(--ease)}
.dgs-page .dgs-irow:hover .dgs-irow-m::after{transform:translate(5px,-5px)}
@media(max-width:860px){.dgs-page .dgs-irow{grid-template-columns:44px 1fr auto}.dgs-page .dgs-irow-d{display:none}}

/* ---------- Location cards ---------- */
.dgs-page .dgs-loc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px}
@media(max-width:1100px){.dgs-page .dgs-loc-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:600px){.dgs-page .dgs-loc-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.dgs-page .dgs-loc{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:280px;padding:26px 24px;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;
  text-decoration:none;color:#fff;border:1px solid var(--ln);background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.05),rgba(255,255,255,.02));
  transition:transform .4s var(--ease),border-color .4s,box-shadow .4s}
.dgs-page .dgs-loc::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:24px;right:24px;height:3px;border-radius:0 0 99px 99px;background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;opacity:.7}
.dgs-page .dgs-loc:hover{transform:translateY(-8px);border-color:rgba(233,30,140,.42);box-shadow:0 26px 70px rgba(233,30,140,.16)}
.dgs-page .dgs-loc-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:auto}
.dgs-page .dgs-loc-num{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--dim)}
.dgs-page .dgs-loc-arrow{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid var(--ln2);font-size:17px;transition:.4s var(--ease)}
.dgs-page .dgs-loc:hover .dgs-loc-arrow{background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;border-color:transparent;transform:rotate(45deg)}
.dgs-page .dgs-loc h3{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(21px,2vw,25px);letter-spacing:-.015em;margin:34px 0 12px;color:#fff}
.dgs-page .dgs-loc p{font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.75;color:var(--mu);margin-bottom:22px}
.dgs-page .dgs-loc-tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.dgs-page .dgs-loc-tags span{padding:8px 12px;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid var(--ln);font-family:var(--fm);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mu)}

/* ---------- CTA ---------- */
.dgs-page .dgs-cta{position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:clamp(90px,12vw,170px) 0;text-align:center;
  background:
  radial-gradient(70% 90% at 50% 120%,rgba(255,107,53,.13),transparent 60%),
  radial-gradient(70% 90% at 50% -20%,rgba(233,30,140,.13),transparent 60%),#000}
.dgs-page .dgs-cta-title{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(44px,7.4vw,104px);line-height:.98;letter-spacing:-.035em;margin:0 auto 26px;max-width:1050px;text-transform:uppercase}
.dgs-page .dgs-cta-sub{max-width:660px;margin:0 auto 40px;font-size:clamp(15.5px,1.4vw,18px);line-height:1.85;color:var(--mu)}
.dgs-page .dgs-cta-btns{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;justify-content:center}

/* ---------- FAQ ---------- */
.dgs-page .dgs-faq{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto}
.dgs-page .dgs-faq-item{border:1px solid var(--ln);border-radius:18px;margin-bottom:14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.02);overflow:hidden;transition:border-color .35s,background .35s}
.dgs-page .dgs-faq-item:hover{border-color:rgba(233,30,140,.32)}
.dgs-page .dgs-faq-item.on{border-color:rgba(233,30,140,.45);background:rgba(255,255,255,.03)}
.dgs-page .dgs-faq-q{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:22px;padding:clamp(20px,2.6vw,28px) clamp(22px,3vw,30px);
  font-family:var(--fd);font-size:clamp(17px,1.7vw,20px);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em;cursor:pointer;color:#fff;user-select:none}
.dgs-page .dgs-faq-q:focus-visible{outline:2px solid rgba(233,30,140,.6);outline-offset:-2px;border-radius:18px}
.dgs-page .dgs-faq-plus{flex-shrink:0;width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--ln2);display:grid;place-items:center;
  font-family:var(--fb);font-weight:300;font-size:19px;color:#fff;transition:transform .45s var(--ease),background .35s,border-color .35s}
.dgs-page .dgs-faq-item.on .dgs-faq-plus{transform:rotate(135deg);background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;border-color:transparent}
.dgs-page .dgs-faq-a{display:grid;grid-template-rows:0fr;transition:grid-template-rows .55s var(--ease)}
.dgs-page .dgs-faq-item.on .dgs-faq-a{grid-template-rows:1fr}
.dgs-page .dgs-faq-a>div{overflow:hidden}
.dgs-page .dgs-faq-a p{padding:0 clamp(22px,3vw,30px) 26px;font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.85;color:var(--mu);max-width:720px}

(function () {
  "use strict";

  var root = document.querySelector("#client-case-studies");
  if (!root) return;

  var isElementorEditor =
    document.body.classList.contains("elementor-editor-active") ||
    window.location.href.indexOf("elementor-preview") !== -1;

  if (isElementorEditor) return;

  function lockScroll() {
    document.documentElement.classList.add("dgs-modal-open");
    document.body.classList.add("dgs-modal-open");
  }

  function unlockScroll() {
    if (!root.querySelector(".modal.on")) {
      document.documentElement.classList.remove("dgs-modal-open");
      document.body.classList.remove("dgs-modal-open");
    }
  }

  root.querySelectorAll("[data-case-modal]").forEach(function (card) {
    function openCaseModal() {
      var modalKey = card.getAttribute("data-case-modal");
      var modal = root.querySelector("#case-modal-" + modalKey);
      if (!modal) return;

      modal.classList.add("on");
      modal.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
      lockScroll();
    }

    card.addEventListener("click", openCaseModal);

    card.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
      if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
        event.preventDefault();
        openCaseModal();
      }
    });
  });

  root.querySelectorAll(".modal").forEach(function (modal) {
    var closeButton = modal.querySelector(".mx");

    function closeModal() {
      modal.classList.remove("on");
      modal.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      unlockScroll();
    }

    if (closeButton) {
      closeButton.addEventListener("click", closeModal);
    }

    modal.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
      if (event.target === modal) closeModal();
    });
  });

  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
    if (event.key !== "Escape") return;

    root.querySelectorAll(".modal.on").forEach(function (modal) {
      modal.classList.remove("on");
      modal.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    });

    unlockScroll();
  });
})();
</script>

<!-- HOW TO CHOOSE -->
<section class="dgs-sec dgs-sec--line" id="how-to-choose">

    <h2 class="dgs-h2" data-rv-lines style="margin-bottom:28px">How to choose the <span class="gt">best SEO company</span> in Pune</h2>
    <p class="dgs-note" data-rv style="margin-top:0;margin-bottom:16px">The best SEO company for your business should explain <strong>what will be done, why it matters, and how progress will be measured</strong>. Before choosing an SEO agency in India or a team serving Pune, check whether they understand your industry, competitors, website issues, target locations, and the type of leads you want.</p>
    <p class="dgs-note" data-rv style="margin-top:0">Serious SEO services for business growth connect technical improvements, content, authority, local visibility, and conversion tracking. Generic providers focus on activity volume without explaining how that work supports enquiries or revenue.</p>
    <ol class="dgs-steps">
      <li data-rv><span class="n">01</span><span class="tx"><strong>Ask for a proper audit —</strong> technical health, content gaps, local signals, competitors, and tracking setup before any plan is suggested.</span></li>
      <li data-rv><span class="n">02</span><span class="tx"><strong>Check how they explain strategy —</strong> if the explanation is only backlinks and keywords, the plan is incomplete.</span></li>
      <li data-rv><span class="n">03</span><span class="tx"><strong>Look for useful proof —</strong> case studies, Search Console growth, ranking movement, and lead improvements beat vague promises.</span></li>
      <li data-rv><span class="n">04</span><span class="tx"><strong>Understand the reporting —</strong> you should know what improved, what is pending, and what actions are planned next.</span></li>
      <li data-rv><span class="n">05</span><span class="tx"><strong>Avoid guaranteed ranking claims —</strong> serious SEO depends on competition, website quality, content, technical health, and time.</span></li>
    </ol>
  </div>
</section>

/* Awards Section */
.dgs-awards-section {
  padding: 82px 20px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01);
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
}

.dgs-awards-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 22px;
  max-width: 1180px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.dgs-award-card {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10);
  border-radius: 18px;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
  transition: all 0.35s ease;
  backdrop-filter: blur(24px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px);
}

.dgs-award-card::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 3px;
  background: var(--gradient-brand);
  opacity: 0.9;
  z-index: 2;

.dgs-award-card:hover {

  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;

.dgs-award-image img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: contain;
  display: block;
  image-rendering: auto;
}

.dgs-award-body {
  padding: 24px 24px 28px;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
}

.dgs-award-tag {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 5px 12px;
  border-radius: 99px;

  border: 1px solid rgba(233,30,140,0.22);

  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1.4px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.dgs-award-title {
  font-size: 19px;
  line-height: 1.35;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #ffffff;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.dgs-award-desc {
  font-size: 14.5px;
  line-height: 1.7;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.68);
  margin: 0;
}

@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .dgs-awards-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));

}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .dgs-awards-section {
    padding: 70px 20px;
  }

  .dgs-awards-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .dgs-award-image {

  }
}
/* Content */

}

.dgs-content-section.alt-bg {

.dgs-content-wrapper {

  margin: 0 auto;
}

.dgs-content-wrapper h2 {

}

.dgs-content-wrapper h3 {

.dgs-content-wrapper p {

.dgs-content-wrapper strong {

}

.dgs-content-wrapper a,

/* Local SEO City Cards */
.dgs-city-section {
  padding: 82px 20px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01);
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
}

.dgs-city-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 18px;
  max-width: 1180px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.dgs-city-card {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 26px 22px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: all 0.35s ease;
  min-height: 220px;
}

.dgs-city-card::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 3px;
  background: var(--gradient-brand);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.35s ease;
}

.dgs-city-card::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  width: 120px;
  height: 120px;
  right: -45px;
  bottom: -55px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(233,30,140,0.16) 0%, transparent 68%);
  filter: blur(8px);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.35s ease;
}

.dgs-city-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-6px);
  border-color: rgba(233,30,140,0.34);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  box-shadow: 0 18px 52px rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.12);
}

.dgs-city-card:hover::before,
.dgs-city-card:hover::after {
  opacity: 1;
}

.dgs-city-tag {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1.4px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.66);
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.dgs-city-tag::before {
  content: '';
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--gradient-brand);
}

.dgs-city-title {
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.28;
  color: #ffffff;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.dgs-city-desc {
  font-size: 14.5px;
  line-height: 1.72;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.68);
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.dgs-city-keywords {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-top: auto;
}

.dgs-city-keywords span {
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1;
  padding: 7px 9px;
  border-radius: 99px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.72);
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
}

@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .dgs-city-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .dgs-city-section {
    padding: 70px 20px;
  }

  .dgs-city-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .dgs-city-card {
    min-height: auto;
  }
}

/* Numbered Steps */
.dgs-numbered-steps {
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 28px 0;
  counter-reset: steps;
}

.dgs-numbered-steps li {
  counter-increment: steps;
  font-size: 17px;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
  line-height: 1.75;
  padding: 18px 20px 18px 64px;
  position: relative;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  border-radius: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.dgs-numbered-steps li:hover {
  border-color: rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.3);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
}

.dgs-numbered-steps li::before {
  content: counter(steps);
  position: absolute;
  left: 20px;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--brand-magenta);
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.4);
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

/* Section Header */
.dgs-section-header {
  text-align: center;
  max-width: 900px;
  margin: 0 auto 48px;
}

.dgs-section-tag {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 8px 20px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
  border-radius: 50px;
  font-size: 13px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
  font-weight: 500;
}

.dgs-section-title {
  font-size: clamp(36px, 6vw, 54px);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.dgs-section-subtitle {
  font-size: 19px;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
  line-height: 1.8;
}

/* Pillars */
.dgs-pillars-section {
  padding: 82px 20px;
}

.dgs-pillars-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 22px;
  max-width: 1180px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.dgs-pillar-card {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  border-left: 3px solid transparent;
  border-image: var(--gradient-brand) 1;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 34px;
  transition: all 0.4s ease;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.dgs-pillar-card::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(233,30,140,0.05) 0%, rgba(255,107,53,0.05) 100%);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.4s ease;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.dgs-pillar-card:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  transform: translateY(-6px);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.1);
}

.dgs-pillar-card:hover::before {
  opacity: 1;
}

.dgs-pillar-number {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  background: var(--gradient-brand);
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  background-clip: text;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
  letter-spacing: 1.5px;
}

.dgs-pillar-title {
  font-size: 23px;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.dgs-pillar-description {
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
  line-height: 1.75;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  font-size: 16px;
}

.dgs-pillar-list {
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
}

.dgs-pillar-list li {
  padding: 8px 0 8px 24px;
  position: relative;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72);
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.dgs-pillar-list li:before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 17px;
  width: 12px;
  height: 2px;
  background: var(--gradient-brand);
}

  background: var(--gradient-brand);

  transition: opacity 0.4s ease;
}

.dgs-impact-card:hover {

  border-color: rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.35);
  box-shadow: 0 15px 50px rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.12);
}

.dgs-impact-card:hover::before {
  opacity: 1;
}

.dgs-impact-title {
  font-size: 19px;
  font-weight: 700;

.dgs-impact-desc {

.dgs-impact-link {

/* CTA Mid */
.dgs-cta-section {
  padding: 82px 20px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(233,30,140,0.05) 0%, rgba(185,30,140,0.05) 50%, rgba(255,107,53,0.05) 100%);

  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
  border-radius: 24px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.15);
}

.dgs-cta-title {
  font-size: clamp(34px, 6vw, 50px);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.dgs-cta-description {
  font-size: 18px;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.78);
  margin-bottom: 32px;
  line-height: 1.8;
}

.dgs-cta-buttons {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 18px;

}

/* FAQ */
.dgs-faq-section {
  padding: 82px 20px;
}

.dgs-faq-container {
  max-width: 950px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.dgs-faq-item {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  border-radius: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.dgs-faq-item:hover {
  border-color: rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.3);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.1);
}

.dgs-faq-question {
  padding: 28px;
  font-size: 19px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 24px;
}

.dgs-faq-answer {
  padding: 0 28px 28px;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
  line-height: 1.8;
  font-size: 17px;
  display: none;
}

.dgs-faq-item.active .dgs-faq-answer {
  display: block;
}

.dgs-faq-toggle {
  font-size: 24px;
  transition: transform 0.3s ease;
  background: var(--gradient-brand);
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  background-clip: text;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.dgs-faq-item.active .dgs-faq-toggle {
  transform: rotate(45deg);
}

/* Final CTA */
.dgs-final-cta {
  padding: 82px 20px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01);
}

.dgs-final-cta-container {
  max-width: 900px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  text-align: center;
}

.dgs-final-cta-container h2 {
  font-size: clamp(36px, 6vw, 54px);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.dgs-final-cta-container > p {
  font-size: 19px;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
  margin-bottom: 42px;
  line-height: 1.8;
}

.dgs-form-shortcode {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);

  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 42px;
  margin-bottom: 38px;

.dgs-contact-info {

  justify-content: center;

}

.dgs-contact-item {

  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 16px 24px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
  border-radius: 10px;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85) !important;
  text-decoration: none;
  font-size: 16px;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.dgs-contact-item:hover {
  border-color: var(--brand-magenta);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.2);
  transform: translateY(-2px);

/* Fluent Form Dark Theme */
.dgs-form-shortcode .fluentform,
.dgs-form-shortcode form {
  text-align: left;
}

.dgs-form-shortcode .ff-el-group {
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.dgs-form-shortcode label,
.dgs-form-shortcode .ff-el-input--label label {
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.82) !important;
  font-size: 14px !important;
  font-weight: 500 !important;
  margin-bottom: 8px !important;
}

.dgs-form-shortcode input,
.dgs-form-shortcode textarea,
.dgs-form-shortcode select,
.dgs-form-shortcode .ff-el-form-control {
  width: 100% !important;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.16) !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  border-radius: 10px !important;
  min-height: 48px !important;
  padding: 13px 15px !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
  outline: none !important;
}

.dgs-form-shortcode textarea,
.dgs-form-shortcode textarea.ff-el-form-control {
  min-height: 120px !important;
}

.dgs-form-shortcode input::placeholder,
.dgs-form-shortcode textarea::placeholder {
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.42) !important;
}

.dgs-form-shortcode input:focus,
.dgs-form-shortcode textarea:focus,
.dgs-form-shortcode select:focus,
.dgs-form-shortcode .ff-el-form-control:focus {
  border-color: var(--brand-magenta) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(233,30,140,0.14) !important;
}

.dgs-form-shortcode .ff-btn-submit,
.dgs-form-shortcode button[type="submit"],
.dgs-form-shortcode input[type="submit"] {
  background: linear-gradient(270deg, var(--brand-magenta), var(--brand-purple), var(--brand-orange), var(--brand-magenta)) !important;
  background-size: 400% 400% !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  border: 0 !important;
  border-radius: 10px !important;
  padding: 15px 30px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  font-size: 16px !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  animation: gradientPulse 4s ease infinite !important;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.28) !important;
}

.dgs-form-shortcode .ff-btn-submit:hover,
.dgs-form-shortcode button[type="submit"]:hover,
.dgs-form-shortcode input[type="submit"]:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 42px rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.38) !important;
}

.dgs-form-shortcode .ff_form_title,
.dgs-form-shortcode .fluentform .ff-form-title {
  display: none !important;
}

/* LLM Upgrade / Proof Section */
.llm-upgrade,
.llm-upgrade * {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  font-family: 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif;
}

.llm-upgrade {
  --bg: #07060D;
  --bg2: #0D0B18;
  --bg3: #141122;
  --silver: #F0EDF8;

  /* Heading hierarchy fix:
     Some Elementor/global header templates output the CTA text "Let's Talk Growth" as an H2 before the page H1.
     This safely converts only that CTA heading into a span without changing the visual design.
     Best permanent fix: edit the global header template and set that CTA widget HTML tag to span/div. */
  function dgsFixGlobalHeaderHeading() {
    var headings = document.querySelectorAll("h2");
    headings.forEach(function (heading) {
      var text = (heading.textContent || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().toLowerCase();
      if (text === "let's talk growth" || text === "lets talk growth") {
        var replacement = document.createElement("span");
        replacement.innerHTML = heading.innerHTML;

        for (var i = 0; i < heading.attributes.length; i++) {
          var attr = heading.attributes[i];
          replacement.setAttribute(attr.name, attr.value);
        }

        replacement.classList.add("dgs-header-cta-text");
        replacement.setAttribute("role", "text");
        heading.parentNode.replaceChild(replacement, heading);
      }
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", dgsFixGlobalHeaderHeading);
  } else {
    dgsFixGlobalHeaderHeading();
  }
})();

      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .dgs-section-title {
      font-size: clamp(38px, 6vw, 54px);
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .dgs-section-subtitle {
      font-size: 19px;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
      line-height: 1.8;
    }

    /* ─── APPROACH / PILLARS ───────────────────────── */
    .dgs-pillars-section { padding: 120px 20px; }

    .dgs-pillars-grid {
      display: grid;
      gap: 28px;
      max-width: 1100px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .dgs-pillar-card {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
      border-left: 3px solid transparent;
      border-image: var(--gradient-brand) 1;
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 42px;
      transition: all 0.4s ease;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .dgs-pillar-card::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0; left: 0;
      width: 100%; height: 100%;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(233,30,140,0.05) 0%, rgba(255,107,53,0.05) 100%);
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.4s ease;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .dgs-pillar-card:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
      transform: translateX(10px);
      box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.1);
    }

    .dgs-pillar-card:hover::before { opacity: 1; }

    .dgs-pillar-number {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 600;
      background: var(--gradient-brand);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      background-clip: text;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      letter-spacing: 1.5px;
    }

    .dgs-pillar-title {
      font-size: 26px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .dgs-pillar-description {
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
      line-height: 1.8;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      font-size: 17px;
    }

    .dgs-pillar-list {
      list-style: none;
      padding: 0;
    }

    .dgs-pillar-list li {
      padding: 10px 0;
      padding-left: 28px;
      position: relative;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
      font-size: 16px;
    }

    .dgs-pillar-list li:before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      left: 0; top: 16px;
      width: 14px; height: 2px;
      background: var(--gradient-brand);
    }

    /* ─── IMPACT CARDS ─────────────────────────────── */
    .dgs-impact-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 28px;
      margin: 40px 0;
      align-items: stretch;
    }

    .dgs-impact-card {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
      border-radius: 14px;
      padding: 36px 28px;
      transition: all 0.4s ease;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .dgs-impact-card::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
      height: 3px;
      background: var(--gradient-brand);
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.4s ease;
    }

    .dgs-impact-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      border-color: rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.35);
      box-shadow: 0 15px 50px rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.12);
    }

    .dgs-impact-card:hover::before { opacity: 1; }

    .dgs-impact-title {
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .dgs-impact-desc {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
      line-height: 1.75;
    }

    /* ─── CTA SECTION ──────────────────────────────── */
    .dgs-cta-section {
      padding: 120px 20px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(233,30,140,0.05) 0%, rgba(185,30,140,0.05) 50%, rgba(255,107,53,0.05) 100%);
      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .dgs-cta-content {
      max-width: 800px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      padding: 60px 40px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
      backdrop-filter: blur(30px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(30px);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
      border-radius: 24px;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.15);
    }

    .dgs-cta-title {
      font-size: clamp(38px, 6vw, 54px);
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .dgs-cta-description {
      font-size: 19px;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
      margin-bottom: 48px;
      line-height: 1.8;
    }

    .dgs-cta-buttons {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 18px;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    /* ─── FAQ ──────────────────────────────────────── */
    .dgs-faq-section { padding: 120px 20px; }

    .dgs-faq-container {
      max-width: 950px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .dgs-faq-item {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
      border-radius: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
    }

    .dgs-faq-item:hover {
      border-color: rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.3);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.1);
    }

    .dgs-faq-question {
      padding: 28px;
      font-size: 19px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .dgs-faq-answer {
      padding: 0 28px 28px;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
      line-height: 1.8;
      font-size: 17px;
      display: none;
    }

    .dgs-faq-item.active .dgs-faq-answer { display: block; }

    .dgs-faq-toggle {
      font-size: 24px;
      transition: transform 0.3s ease;
      background: var(--gradient-brand);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      background-clip: text;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .dgs-faq-item.active .dgs-faq-toggle { transform: rotate(45deg); }

    /* ─── FINAL CTA ────────────────────────────────── */
    .dgs-final-cta {
      padding: 120px 20px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01);
    }

    .dgs-final-cta-container {
      max-width: 800px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .dgs-final-cta-container h2 {
      font-size: clamp(38px, 6vw, 54px);
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .dgs-final-cta-container > p {
      font-size: 19px;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
      margin-bottom: 50px;
      line-height: 1.8;
    }

    .dgs-form-shortcode {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
      backdrop-filter: blur(30px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(30px);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 50px;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.1);
    }
.dgs-contact-info {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 28px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .dgs-contact-item {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 16px 28px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
      border-radius: 10px;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-size: 16px;
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
    }

    .dgs-contact-item:hover {
      border-color: var(--brand-magenta);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.2);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .dgs-contact-item svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }

    /* ─── RESPONSIVE ───────────────────────────────── */
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .dgs-hero-cta { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; }
      .dgs-btn-primary, .dgs-btn-secondary, .dgs-btn-whatsapp { justify-content: center; }
      .dgs-clients-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 30px; }
      .dgs-content-section, .dgs-pillars-section { padding: 80px 20px; }
      .dgs-impact-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .dgs-cta-content { padding: 40px 28px; }
      .dgs-form-shortcode { padding: 32px 24px; }
      .dgs-pillar-card { padding: 32px; }
    }

    .dgs-inline-link{
      color:#ffffff;
      text-decoration:none;
      border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
      transition:all 0.25s ease;
    }
    .dgs-inline-link:hover{
      color:#ffffff;
      border-bottom-color: var(--brand-magenta);
      box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(233,30,140,0.35);
    }
    .dgs-updated-line{
      margin-top:24px;
      font-size:14px;
      color:rgba(255,255,255,0.58);
      letter-spacing:.02em;
      animation: fadeInUp 1.25s ease-out 0.7s backwards;
    }
    .dgs-updated-line strong{color:#fff;font-weight:600;}


.llm-upgrade, .llm-upgrade * { box-sizing:border-box; font-family:Inter, Arial, sans-serif; }
.llm-upgrade{
  --bg:#07060D; --bg2:#0D0B18; --bg3:#141122;
  --silver:#F0EDF8; --body:#C8C5D8; --muted:#8A87A0; --dim:#5C596E;
  --line:rgba(255,255,255,.08); --ln2:rgba(255,255,255,.15);
  --green:#22C55E;
  color:var(--body);
}
.llm-upgrade img{display:block;max-width:100%;}
.llm-upgrade .w{max-width:1360px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px;}
.llm-upgrade .ws{max-width:860px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px;}
.llm-upgrade .sec{padding:72px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
.llm-upgrade .sh{text-align:center;margin-bottom:38px;}
.llm-upgrade .ew{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:14px;}
.llm-upgrade .ewl{width:18px;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#E8612A,#6247B0);}
.llm-upgrade .gt,.llm-upgrade .ewt{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#E8612A,#C43F7A,#6247B0,#C43F7A,#E8612A);
  background-size:300% 300%;
  -webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;
  animation:llmGradientShift 5s ease infinite;
}
.llm-upgrade .sh h2{font-size:clamp(30px,4vw,48px);line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-1.5px;color:var(--silver);margin:0 0 10px;}
.llm-upgrade .sh p{font-size:15px;color:var(--muted);max-width:740px;margin:0 auto;line-height:1.7;}
@keyframes llmGradientShift{0%,100%{background-position:0% 50%}50%{background-position:100% 50%}}

.llm-upgrade .clrow{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.llm-upgrade .clchip{height:58px;width:136px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.02);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:10px 14px;overflow:hidden;transition:.25s}
.llm-upgrade .clchip:hover{border-color:rgba(196,63,122,.28);background:rgba(196,63,122,.04);transform:translateY(-3px)}
.llm-upgrade .clchip img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;filter:brightness(.85) saturate(.55)}
.llm-upgrade .clchip:hover img{filter:brightness(1.05) saturate(.95)}

.llm-upgrade .bento-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px}
.llm-upgrade .bi{border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg2);position:relative;cursor:pointer;transition:.28s}
.llm-upgrade .bi:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:var(--ln2);box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.llm-upgrade .bi img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.llm-upgrade .bio{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;padding:14px 16px;background:linear-gradient(to top,rgba(7,6,13,.94),transparent)}
.llm-upgrade .bipill{display:inline-block;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:5px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#E8612A,#C43F7A);color:#fff;margin-bottom:5px}
.llm-upgrade .bittl{font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:var(--silver)}
.llm-upgrade .bizoom{position:absolute;top:10px;right:10px;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:7px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);border:1px solid var(--ln2);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;opacity:0;transition:.2s}
.llm-upgrade .bi:hover .bizoom{opacity:1}
.llm-upgrade .bizoom svg{width:13px;height:13px;stroke:#fff;stroke-width:2;fill:none}

.llm-upgrade .lb{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:99999;background:rgba(3,2,9,.96);backdrop-filter:blur(22px);display:none;flex-direction:column}
.llm-upgrade .lb.on{display:flex}
.llm-upgrade .lbtop{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:14px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(13,11,24,.97)}
.llm-upgrade .lbtl{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.llm-upgrade .lbpill{display:inline-block;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:5px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#E8612A,#C43F7A);color:#fff}
.llm-upgrade .lbttl{font-size:15px;font-weight:500;color:var(--silver)}
.llm-upgrade .lbcount{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-right:8px}
.llm-upgrade .lbbtn{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);border:1px solid var(--ln2);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;color:var(--muted);font-size:18px}
.llm-upgrade .lbbody{flex:1;overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:24px;gap:20px;scroll-behavior:smooth}
.llm-upgrade .lbimg{height:calc(100vh - 120px);width:auto;max-width:none;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--ln2);box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.6);object-fit:contain}

.llm-upgrade .csg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:22px}
.llm-upgrade .csc{border-radius:18px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg2);overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;position:relative;transition:.3s}
.llm-upgrade .csc::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#E8612A,#C43F7A,#6247B0)}
.llm-upgrade .csc:hover{transform:translateY(-7px);border-color:var(--ln2);box-shadow:0 28px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.llm-upgrade .csss{height:190px;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
.llm-upgrade .csss::after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:55px;background:linear-gradient(to top,var(--bg2),transparent)}
.llm-upgrade .csss img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:top}
.llm-upgrade .csbody{padding:22px 26px 24px}
.llm-upgrade .cslogo{height:30px;margin-bottom:13px}
.llm-upgrade .cslogo img{height:100%;width:auto;object-fit:contain}
.llm-upgrade .cstag{display:inline-block;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:4px 11px;border-radius:100px;margin-bottom:12px;background:rgba(232,97,42,.1);color:#E8612A;border:1px solid rgba(232,97,42,.2)}
.llm-upgrade .csbody h3{font-size:17px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.4px;color:var(--silver);margin:0 0 9px;line-height:1.3}
.llm-upgrade .csbody > p{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.68;margin:0 0 18px}
.llm-upgrade .csnums{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:9px;margin-bottom:14px}
.llm-upgrade .cnum{text-align:center;padding:12px 5px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px}
.llm-upgrade .cnum strong{display:block;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;line-height:1;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#E8612A,#C43F7A,#6247B0,#C43F7A,#E8612A);background-size:300% 300%;-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;animation:llmGradientShift 5s ease infinite}
.llm-upgrade .cnum span{font-size:10px;color:var(--dim);text-transform:uppercase}
.llm-upgrade .csview{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#E8612A,#C43F7A,#6247B0,#C43F7A,#E8612A);background-size:300% 300%;-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;animation:llmGradientShift 5s ease infinite}
.llm-upgrade .csft{padding:12px 26px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}
.llm-upgrade .csav{width:25px;height:25px;border-radius:6px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#E8612A,#C43F7A);color:#fff;flex-shrink:0}
.llm-upgrade .csfn{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.llm-upgrade .cstm{margin-left:auto;font-size:11px;color:var(--dim)}

.llm-upgrade .mqwrap{position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:8px 0;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(to right,transparent,black 10%,black 90%,transparent);mask-image:linear-gradient(to right,transparent,black 10%,black 90%,transparent)}
.llm-upgrade .mqtrack{display:flex;gap:12px;width:max-content;animation:llmMarquee 120s linear infinite}
.llm-upgrade .mqtrack:hover{animation-play-state:paused}
@keyframes llmMarquee{0%{transform:translateX(0)}100%{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
.llm-upgrade .nc{flex-shrink:0;width:168px;height:74px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.02);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:9px 13px;overflow:hidden}
.llm-upgrade .nc img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;opacity:.72}
.llm-upgrade .nc:hover img{opacity:1}

.llm-upgrade .tg2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px}
.llm-upgrade .tc{background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:30px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.llm-upgrade .tc::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#E8612A,#C43F7A);opacity:0;transition:.3s}
.llm-upgrade .tc:hover{border-color:var(--ln2)}
.llm-upgrade .tc:hover::before{opacity:1}
.llm-upgrade .tcstars{color:#FBBF24;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:14px;display:block}
.llm-upgrade .tcq{font-size:15px;line-height:1.75;color:var(--body);margin:0 0 20px;padding-left:18px;position:relative}
.llm-upgrade .tcq::before{content:'"';position:absolute;left:0;top:-4px;font-size:42px;line-height:1;font-weight:700;opacity:.4;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#E8612A,#C43F7A,#6247B0,#C43F7A,#E8612A);background-size:300% 300%;-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;animation:llmGradientShift 5s ease infinite}
.llm-upgrade .tcauth{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px}
.llm-upgrade .tcav{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:9px;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#E8612A,#C43F7A);color:#fff;flex-shrink:0}
.llm-upgrade .tcnm{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--silver);display:block}
.llm-upgrade .tcrl{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);display:block;margin-top:1px}
.llm-upgrade .tcco{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;display:block;margin-top:2px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#E8612A,#C43F7A,#6247B0,#C43F7A,#E8612A);background-size:300% 300%;-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;animation:llmGradientShift 5s ease infinite}

.llm-upgrade .fq{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.llm-upgrade .fqbtn{width:100%;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:20px 0;cursor:pointer;gap:16px;background:none;border:none;text-align:left;color:inherit}
.llm-upgrade .fqq{font-size:16px;font-weight:500;color:var(--body);flex:1}
.llm-upgrade .fqic{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--ln2);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;font-size:16px;color:var(--muted);transition:.3s}
.llm-upgrade .fq.open .fqic{transform:rotate(45deg);border-color:rgba(196,63,122,.5);color:#C43F7A}
.llm-upgrade .fqbody{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height .38s ease,padding .38s}
.llm-upgrade .fq.open .fqbody{max-height:240px;padding-bottom:20px}
