          <div class="dgs-faq-container">

            <div class="dgs-faq-item">
              <div class="dgs-faq-question">
                <span>What is LLM SEO?</span>
                <span class="dgs-faq-toggle">+</span>
              </div>
              <div class="dgs-faq-answer">
                LLM SEO is the practice of structuring your content so large language models can understand, trust, and reference your brand inside AI-generated answers. It focuses on authority, clarity, entity consistency, and answer-ready content rather than only traditional ranking signals.
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="dgs-faq-item">
              <div class="dgs-faq-question">
                <span>How is LLM SEO different from traditional SEO?</span>
                <span class="dgs-faq-toggle">+</span>
              </div>
              <div class="dgs-faq-answer">
                Traditional SEO focuses on ranking pages in search engines. LLM SEO focuses on making your brand authoritative enough to be included inside AI-generated responses from systems like ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and AI Overviews. The strongest strategy uses both together.
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="dgs-faq-item">
              <div class="dgs-faq-question">
                <span>How to get cited in AI answers?</span>
                <span class="dgs-faq-toggle">+</span>
              </div>
              <div class="dgs-faq-answer">
                Clear service explanations, strong topical depth, crawlable internal links, structured formatting, consistent brand signals, experience-backed insights, and proof of expertise improve your chances of citation. Citation comes from trust and relevance, not from stuffing keywords.
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="dgs-faq-item">
              <div class="dgs-faq-question">
                <span>Can LLM SEO work together with AEO, GEO, and traditional SEO?</span>
                <span class="dgs-faq-toggle">+</span>
              </div>
              <div class="dgs-faq-answer">
                Yes. LLM SEO works best when paired with traditional SEO, AEO, and GEO. Traditional SEO strengthens rankings, AEO improves direct-answer visibility, GEO improves generative search visibility, and LLM SEO helps your brand become more reference-worthy across AI systems.
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="dgs-faq-item">
              <div class="dgs-faq-question">
                <span>Does LLM SEO improve ROI?</span>
                <span class="dgs-faq-toggle">+</span>
              </div>
              <div class="dgs-faq-answer">
                Yes. Higher AI visibility improves trust, supports better-quality inbound traffic, reduces long-term dependency on paid acquisition, and increases the chance that your brand is shortlisted before a user even clicks through to your website.
              </div>
            </div>

<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');

* {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.dgs-geo-page {
  font-family: 'DM Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
  background: #000000;
  color: #ffffff;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.dgs-geo-page {
  --brand-magenta: #E91E8C;
  --brand-purple: #B91E8C;
  --brand-orange: #FF6B35;
  --gradient-brand: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--brand-magenta) 0%, var(--brand-purple) 50%, var(--brand-orange) 100%);
  --card-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035);
  --card-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10);
  --text-soft: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.76);
  --text-muted: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.58);
}

.dgs-geo-page a {
  color: inherit;
}

.dgs-container {
  max-width: 1200px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 20px;
}

/* ─── ANIMATIONS ───────────────────────────────────── */
@keyframes gradientPulse {
  0%, 100% { background-position: 0% 50%; filter: brightness(1); }
  50% { background-position: 100% 50%; filter: brightness(1.25); }
}

@keyframes pulse {
  0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.7); }
  50% { transform: scale(1.25); opacity: 0.82; box-shadow: 0 0 0 10px rgba(233, 30, 140, 0); }
}

@keyframes float {
  0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1) rotate(0deg); }
  33% { transform: translate(35px, -35px) scale(1.12) rotate(5deg); }
  66% { transform: translate(-25px, 25px) scale(0.92) rotate(-5deg); }
}

@keyframes fadeInUp {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(34px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

.dgs-gradient-text {
  background: linear-gradient(270deg, var(--brand-magenta), var(--brand-purple), var(--brand-orange), var(--brand-magenta));
  background-size: 400% 400%;
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  background-clip: text;
  display: inline-block;
  animation: gradientPulse 4s ease infinite;
}

/* ─── HERO ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
.dgs-geo-hero {
  position: relative;
  min-height: 78vh;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 96px 20px 72px;
}

.dgs-hero-container {
  max-width: 1060px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  text-align: center;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
}

.dgs-elite-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.15);
  border-radius: 50px;
  padding: 11px 24px;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 500;
  margin-bottom: 30px;
  animation: fadeInUp 0.6s ease-out;
  letter-spacing: 0.4px;
}

.dgs-pulse-dot {
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
  background: var(--gradient-brand);
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.dgs-hero-title {
  font-size: clamp(40px, 6.4vw, 66px);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.12;
  margin-bottom: 22px;
  animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease-out 0.2s backwards;
}

.dgs-hero-description {
  font-size: clamp(17px, 2.1vw, 20px);
  color: var(--text-soft);
  max-width: 880px;
  margin: 0 auto 34px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  animation: fadeInUp 1s ease-out 0.4s backwards;
}

.dgs-hero-cta {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 16px;
  animation: fadeInUp 1.2s ease-out 0.6s backwards;
}

.dgs-btn-primary,
.dgs-btn-secondary,
.dgs-btn-whatsapp {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 16px 30px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 16px;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.dgs-btn-primary {
  background: linear-gradient(270deg, var(--brand-magenta), var(--brand-purple), var(--brand-orange), var(--brand-magenta));
  background-size: 400% 400%;
  color: #ffffff;
  animation: gradientPulse 4s ease infinite;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.3);
}

.dgs-btn-primary:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.4);
}

.dgs-btn-secondary,
.dgs-btn-whatsapp {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  color: #ffffff;
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
}

.dgs-btn-secondary:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  border-color: var(--brand-magenta);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.2);
}

.dgs-btn-whatsapp:hover {
  background: rgba(37, 211, 102, 0.15);
  border-color: #25D366;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(37, 211, 102, 0.2);
}

.dgs-hero-bg-element {
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 50%;
  filter: blur(140px);
  opacity: 0.14;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.dgs-hero-bg-1 {
  width: 560px;
  height: 560px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--brand-magenta) 0%, transparent 70%);
  top: -160px;
  left: -160px;
  animation: float 25s ease-in-out infinite, gradientPulse 8s ease infinite;
}

.dgs-hero-bg-2 {
  width: 470px;
  height: 470px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--brand-purple) 0%, transparent 70%);
  top: 38%;
  right: -150px;
  animation: float 30s ease-in-out infinite 5s, gradientPulse 10s ease infinite;
}

.dgs-hero-bg-3 {
  width: 620px;
  height: 620px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--brand-orange) 0%, transparent 70%);
  bottom: -260px;
  left: 35%;
  animation: float 35s ease-in-out infinite 10s, gradientPulse 12s ease infinite;
}

/* ─── CLIENTS ──────────────────────────────────────── */
.dgs-clients {
  padding: 48px 20px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
}

.dgs-clients-title {
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 13px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 2.4px;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45);
  margin-bottom: 30px;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.dgs-clients-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(145px, 1fr));
  gap: 28px;
  align-items: center;
  max-width: 1050px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.dgs-client-logo {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  opacity: 0.7;
  transition: opacity 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease;
}

.dgs-client-logo:hover {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: scale(1.05);
}

.dgs-client-logo img {
  max-width: 128px;
  height: auto;
}

/* ─── SECTION SYSTEM ───────────────────────────────── */
.dgs-section {
  padding: 72px 20px;
}

.dgs-section.alt-bg {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.012);
}

.dgs-section-header {
  text-align: center;
  max-width: 900px;
  margin: 0 auto 42px;
}

.dgs-section-tag {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 8px 18px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
  border-radius: 50px;
  font-size: 12px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
  font-weight: 500;
}

.dgs-section-title {
  font-size: clamp(34px, 5.4vw, 52px);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  line-height: 1.14;
}

.dgs-section-subtitle {
  font-size: 18px;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.70);
  line-height: 1.75;
}

/* ─── COMPACT CONTENT GRID ─────────────────────────── */
.dgs-compact-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.05fr .95fr;
  gap: 22px;
  align-items: stretch;
}

.dgs-compact-card {
  background: var(--card-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 30px;
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.dgs-compact-card::before,
.dgs-feature-card::before,
.dgs-impact-card::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 3px;
  background: var(--gradient-brand);
  opacity: 0.78;
}

.dgs-compact-card h2,
.dgs-compact-card h3 {
  font-size: clamp(24px, 3vw, 34px);
  line-height: 1.22;
  margin: 0 0 16px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.dgs-compact-card p {
  font-size: 16px;
  color: var(--text-soft);
  line-height: 1.76;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.dgs-compact-card p:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.dgs-compact-card strong {
  color: #ffffff;
}

.dgs-quick-list {
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
  list-style: none;
  margin: 18px 0 0;
  padding: 0;
}

.dgs-quick-list li {
  position: relative;
  padding: 13px 15px 13px 38px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.025);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  border-radius: 10px;
  color: var(--text-soft);
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.55;
}

.dgs-quick-list li::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 16px;
  top: 23px;
  width: 13px;
  height: 2px;
  background: var(--gradient-brand);
}

/* ─── FEATURE CARDS ───────────────────────────────── */
.dgs-feature-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 18px;
}

.dgs-feature-card {
  background: var(--card-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 26px 24px;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  height: 100%;
}

.dgs-feature-card:hover,
.dgs-impact-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-5px);
  border-color: rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.35);
  box-shadow: 0 16px 46px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.32);
}

.dgs-card-kicker {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1.3px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--brand-magenta);
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.dgs-feature-card h3 {
  font-size: 20px;
  line-height: 1.28;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.dgs-feature-card p {
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.72;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.68);
}

/* ─── STEP CARDS ──────────────────────────────────── */
.dgs-framework-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 16px;
  align-items: stretch;
  margin-top: 28px;
}

.dgs-framework-card {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 14px;
  min-height: 96px;
  padding: 22px 24px;
  background: #070707;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10);
  border-radius: 16px;
}

.dgs-framework-number {
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  min-width: 28px;
  min-height: 28px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid var(--brand-magenta);
  color: var(--brand-magenta);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1;
  margin-top: 2px;
}

.dgs-framework-title {
  margin: 0;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 18px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  font-weight: 500;
  text-align: left;
}

/* ─── IMPACT CARDS ────────────────────────────────── */
.dgs-impact-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 18px;
}

.dgs-impact-card {
  background: var(--card-bg);
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 26px 24px;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  height: 100%;
}

.dgs-impact-title {
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  color: #ffffff;
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.dgs-impact-desc {
  font-size: 14.5px;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.66);
  line-height: 1.68;
}


/* ─── CASE STUDIES ─────────────────────────────────── */
.dgs-case-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 22px;
  align-items: stretch;
}

.dgs-case-card {
  background: var(--card-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
  border-radius: 18px;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-height: 100%;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.dgs-case-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-6px);
  border-color: rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.35);
  box-shadow: 0 18px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.34);
}

.dgs-case-card::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 3px;
  background: var(--gradient-brand);
  z-index: 2;
}

.dgs-case-image {
  height: 190px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #080808;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
}

.dgs-case-image img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: top;
  display: block;
}

.dgs-case-body {
  padding: 24px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  flex: 1;
}

.dgs-case-logo {
  height: 32px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.dgs-case-logo img {
  height: 100%;
  width: auto;
  max-width: 160px;
  object-fit: contain;
  display: block;
}

.dgs-case-tag {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-self: flex-start;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1.1px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 6px 11px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.10);
  border: 1px solid rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.22);
  color: var(--brand-magenta);
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.dgs-case-title {
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 21px;
  line-height: 1.32;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin: 0 0 12px;
}

.dgs-case-desc {
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.68);
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.7;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.dgs-case-metrics {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 10px;
  margin-top: auto;
}

.dgs-case-metric {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 13px 8px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  border-radius: 10px;
}

.dgs-case-metric strong {
  display: block;
  font-size: 22px;
  line-height: 1;
  font-weight: 800;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  background: linear-gradient(270deg, var(--brand-magenta), var(--brand-purple), var(--brand-orange), var(--brand-magenta));
  background-size: 400% 400%;
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  background-clip: text;
  animation: gradientPulse 4s ease infinite;
}

.dgs-case-metric span {
  display: block;
  font-size: 10px;
  line-height: 1.35;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.52);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.7px;
}

.dgs-case-disclaimer {
  max-width: 860px;
  margin: 26px auto 0;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  line-height: 1.65;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.52);
}

/* ─── CTA ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
.dgs-cta-section {
  padding: 72px 20px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(233,30,140,0.055) 0%, rgba(185,30,140,0.05) 50%, rgba(255,107,53,0.055) 100%);
  text-align: center;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.dgs-cta-content {
  max-width: 880px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  padding: 46px 38px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  backdrop-filter: blur(30px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(30px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
  border-radius: 22px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.15);
}

.dgs-cta-title {
  font-size: clamp(32px, 5vw, 48px);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  line-height: 1.18;
}

.dgs-cta-description {
  font-size: 17px;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.76);
  margin-bottom: 30px;
  line-height: 1.75;
}

.dgs-cta-buttons {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 16px;
  justify-content: center;
}

/* ─── FAQ ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
.dgs-faq-section {
  padding: 72px 20px;
}

.dgs-faq-container {
  max-width: 940px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.dgs-faq-item {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  border-radius: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.dgs-faq-item:hover {
  border-color: rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.3);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.1);
}

.dgs-faq-question {
  padding: 24px 26px;
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 20px;
}

.dgs-faq-answer {
  padding: 0 26px 24px;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
  line-height: 1.78;
  font-size: 16px;
  display: none;
}

.dgs-faq-item.active .dgs-faq-answer {
  display: block;
}

.dgs-faq-toggle {
  font-size: 24px;
  transition: transform 0.3s ease;
  background: var(--gradient-brand);
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  background-clip: text;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.dgs-faq-item.active .dgs-faq-toggle {
  transform: rotate(45deg);
}

/* ─── FORM ────────────────────────────────────────── */
.dgs-final-cta {
  padding: 72px 20px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.012);
}

.dgs-final-cta-container {
  max-width: 900px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  text-align: center;
}

.dgs-final-cta-container h2 {
  font-size: clamp(32px, 5vw, 48px);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  line-height: 1.18;
}

.dgs-final-cta-container > p {
  font-size: 17px;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
  margin-bottom: 34px;
  line-height: 1.75;
}

.dgs-form-shortcode {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  backdrop-filter: blur(30px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(30px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 34px;
  margin-bottom: 34px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.1);
}

.dgs-contact-info {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 22px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.dgs-contact-item {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 15px 24px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);

        <div class="dgs-faq-container">
          <div class="dgs-faq-item">
            <div class="dgs-faq-question">
              <span>What is Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)?</span>
              <span class="dgs-faq-toggle">+</span>
            </div>
            <div class="dgs-faq-answer">
              Generative Engine Optimization, or GEO, is the process of improving how your brand, website, and content are understood by AI-powered search engines and generative answer platforms such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="dgs-faq-item">
            <div class="dgs-faq-question">
              <span>How is GEO different from SEO and AEO?</span>
              <span class="dgs-faq-toggle">+</span>
            </div>
            <div class="dgs-faq-answer">
              SEO focuses on improving rankings in traditional search results. AEO focuses on appearing in direct answers, snippets, and voice results. GEO focuses on improving your brand visibility inside AI-generated recommendations, summaries, citations, and conversational search responses.
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="dgs-faq-item">
            <div class="dgs-faq-question">
              <span>Why does GEO matter for my business?</span>
              <span class="dgs-faq-toggle">+</span>
            </div>
            <div class="dgs-faq-answer">
              GEO matters because more users now ask AI tools to compare, shortlist, and recommend businesses. If your brand is not clearly represented across trusted sources, structured content, and authoritative pages, AI platforms may not understand or mention your business accurately.
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="dgs-faq-item">
            <div class="dgs-faq-question">
              <span>What does a GEO strategy include?</span>
              <span class="dgs-faq-toggle">+</span>
            </div>
            <div class="dgs-faq-answer">
              A GEO strategy includes entity optimization, structured data, authoritative service pages, topical content clusters, digital PR, trusted citations, answer-ready content, internal linking, and improving the consistency of brand information across public sources.
            </div>
          </div>

.dgs-page, .dgs-page *, .dgs-page *::before, .dgs-page *::after{box-sizing:border-box}

.dgs-page{

@keyframes dgshift{to{background-position:-220% 0}}

        <h3 class="dgs-card-h">Crawl checks</h3>

<!-- HOW TO CHOOSE -->
<section class="dgs-sec dgs-sec--line" id="how-to-choose">
  <div class="dgs-wrap dgs-wrap--s">
    <div class="dgs-eyebrow" data-rv>(10) — <em>Buyer's guide</em></div>
    <h2 class="dgs-h2" data-rv-lines style="margin-bottom:28px">How to choose the <span class="gt">best SEO company</span> in Mumbai</h2>
    <p class="dgs-note" data-rv style="margin-top:0;margin-bottom:16px">The best SEO company for your business should explain <strong>what will be done, why it matters, and how progress will be measured</strong>. Before choosing an SEO agency in India or a local Mumbai team, check whether they understand your industry, competitors, website issues, target locations, and the type of leads you want.</p>
    <p class="dgs-note" data-rv style="margin-top:0">Serious SEO services for business growth connect technical improvements, content, authority, local visibility, and conversion tracking. Generic providers focus on activity volume without explaining how that work supports enquiries or revenue.</p>
    <ol class="dgs-steps">
      <li data-rv><span class="n">01</span><span class="tx"><strong>Ask for a proper audit —</strong> technical health, content gaps, local signals, competitors, and tracking setup before any plan is suggested.</span></li>
      <li data-rv><span class="n">02</span><span class="tx"><strong>Check how they explain strategy —</strong> if the explanation is only backlinks and keywords, the plan is incomplete.</span></li>
      <li data-rv><span class="n">03</span><span class="tx"><strong>Look for useful proof —</strong> case studies, Search Console growth, ranking movement, and lead improvements beat vague promises.</span></li>
      <li data-rv><span class="n">04</span><span class="tx"><strong>Understand the reporting —</strong> you should know what improved, what is pending, and what actions are planned next.</span></li>
      <li data-rv><span class="n">05</span><span class="tx"><strong>Avoid guaranteed ranking claims —</strong> serious SEO depends on competition, website quality, content, technical health, and time.</span></li>
    </ol>
  </div>
</section>

    }
    var proof=event.target.closest("[data-lb-open]");if(proof){openLb(parseInt(proof.dataset.lbOpen||"0",10));return;}
    var caseButton=event.target.closest("[data-case-open]");if(caseButton){openModal(caseButton.dataset.caseOpen);return;}
    var close=event.target.closest("#seo-lbx,.dgs-mo-x");
    if(close){if(close.id==="seo-lbx")closeLb();else closeModal(close.closest(".dgs-mo"));return;}
    if(event.target===lightbox||event.target.classList.contains("dgs-lbbody")){closeLb();return;}
    if(event.target.classList.contains("dgs-mo"))closeModal(event.target);
  });
  root.addEventListener("keydown",function(event){
    var faq=event.target.closest&&event.target.closest(".dgs-faq-q");
    if(faq&&(event.key==="Enter"||event.key===" ")){event.preventDefault();faq.click();return;}
    if(event.key==="Escape"){closeLb();root.querySelectorAll(".dgs-mo.on").forEach(closeModal)}
    if(lightbox&&lightbox.classList.contains("on")){
      if(event.key==="ArrowLeft")showLb(lbIndex-1);
      if(event.key==="ArrowRight")showLb(lbIndex+1);
    }
  });
  var prev=root.querySelector("#seo-lbprev"),next=root.querySelector("#seo-lbnext");
  if(prev)prev.addEventListener("click",function(){showLb(lbIndex-1)});
  if(next)next.addEventListener("click",function(){showLb(lbIndex+1)});

  var deferredStarted=false;
  function splitWords(el){
    if(el.dataset.fillReady==="1")return;
    el.dataset.fillReady="1";
    var walker=document.createTreeWalker(el,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT,null),nodes=[],index=0;
    while(walker.nextNode())nodes.push(walker.currentNode);
    nodes.forEach(function(node){
      var frag=document.createDocumentFragment();
      node.nodeValue.split(/(\s+)/).forEach(function(part){
        if(!part)return;
        if(/^\s+$/.test(part)){frag.appendChild(document.createTextNode(part));return;}
        var span=document.createElement("span");span.className="w";span.style.setProperty("--dgs-word-index",String(index++));span.textContent=part;frag.appendChild(span);
      });
      node.parentNode.replaceChild(frag,node);
    });
  }
  function initLazyImages(){
    var images=[].slice.call(root.querySelectorAll("img[data-src]:not(.dgs-mo img)"));
    if(!images.length)return;
    if(!("IntersectionObserver" in window)){images.forEach(loadImage);return;}
    var observer=new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
      entries.forEach(function(entry){if(entry.isIntersecting){loadImage(entry.target);observer.unobserve(entry.target)}});
    },{rootMargin:"160px 0px",threshold:.01});
    images.forEach(function(img){observer.observe(img)});
  }
  function initReveals(){
    if(!matchMedia("(min-width:1025px) and (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference)").matches||!("IntersectionObserver" in window)){
      root.querySelectorAll("[data-rv],[data-rv-lines],[data-fill]").forEach(function(el){el.classList.add("dgs-visible")});return;
    }
    root.classList.add("dgs-js");
    var observer=new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
      entries.forEach(function(entry){
        if(!entry.isIntersecting)return;
        if(entry.target.hasAttribute("data-fill"))splitWords(entry.target);
        entry.target.classList.add("dgs-visible");observer.unobserve(entry.target);
      });
    },{rootMargin:"100px 0px -5% 0px",threshold:.02});
    root.querySelectorAll("[data-rv],[data-rv-lines],[data-fill]").forEach(function(el){observer.observe(el)});
  }
  function initRotator(){
    var rot=root.querySelector("#dgs-rot");
    if(!rot||!matchMedia("(min-width:1025px) and (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference)").matches)return;
    var words=[].slice.call(rot.children),index=0,timer=0;
    words.forEach(function(word,i){word.style.opacity=i?"0":"1";word.style.transform=i?"translate3d(0,70%,0)":"translate3d(0,0,0)";word.style.transition="opacity .4s ease,transform .5s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)"});
    function start(){if(timer||document.hidden)return;timer=setInterval(function(){var current=words[index];index=(index+1)%words.length;var next=words[index];current.style.opacity="0";current.style.transform="translate3d(0,-70%,0)";next.style.opacity="1";next.style.transform="translate3d(0,0,0)"},3200)}
    function stop(){if(timer){clearInterval(timer);timer=0}}
    var hero=root.querySelector(".dgs-hero");
    if(hero&&"IntersectionObserver" in window)new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){entries[0].isIntersecting?start():stop()},{threshold:.05}).observe(hero);else start();
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange",function(){document.hidden?stop():start()},{passive:true});
  }
  function initDesktopEffects(){
    if(!matchMedia("(pointer:fine) and (min-width:1025px) and (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference)").matches)return;
    var dot=root.querySelector(".dgs-cur"),ring=root.querySelector(".dgs-cur2"),mx=0,my=0,rx=0,ry=0,frame=0;
    if(dot&&ring){
      document.body.classList.add("dgs-has-cur");
      function paint(){frame=0;rx+=(mx-rx)*.18;ry+=(my-ry)*.18;dot.style.transform="translate3d("+mx+"px,"+my+"px,0) translate(-50%,-50%)";ring.style.transform="translate3d("+rx+"px,"+ry+"px,0) translate(-50%,-50%)";if(Math.abs(mx-rx)>.1||Math.abs(my-ry)>.1)frame=requestAnimationFrame(paint)}
      window.addEventListener("pointermove",function(event){mx=event.clientX;my=event.clientY;if(!frame)frame=requestAnimationFrame(paint)},{passive:true});
      root.addEventListener("pointerover",function(event){if(event.target.closest("a,button,.dgs-faq-q"))ring.classList.add("hov")});
      root.addEventListener("pointerout",function(event){if(event.target.closest("a,button,.dgs-faq-q"))ring.classList.remove("hov")});
    }
    root.querySelectorAll("[data-mag]").forEach(function(button){
      button.addEventListener("pointermove",function(event){var r=button.getBoundingClientRect();button.style.transform="translate3d("+((event.clientX-r.left-r.width/2)*.12)+"px,"+((event.clientY-r.top-r.height/2)*.15)+"px,0)"});
      button.addEventListener("pointerleave",function(){button.style.transform=""});
    });
  }
  function startDeferred(){
    if(deferredStarted)return;deferredStarted=true;
    initLazyImages();initReveals();initRotator();
  }

  /* Desktop-only decorative effects are initialized only after the first mouse
     movement. They look identical once used but do not compete with LCP/TBT. */
  var desktopEffectsStarted=false;
  function startDesktopEffectsOnce(event){
    if(desktopEffectsStarted)return;
    if(event&&event.pointerType&&event.pointerType!=="mouse")return;
    desktopEffectsStarted=true;
    initDesktopEffects();
  }
  if(matchMedia("(pointer:fine) and (min-width:1025px) and (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference)").matches){
    window.addEventListener("pointermove",startDesktopEffectsOnce,{once:true,passive:true});
  }

  var idle=window.requestIdleCallback||function(callback){return setTimeout(callback,1100)};
  idle(startDeferred,{timeout:2200});
  window.addEventListener("load",function(){setTimeout(startDeferred,450)},{once:true,passive:true});
  ["pointerdown","touchstart","keydown","scroll"].forEach(function(type){document.addEventListener(type,startDeferred,{once:true,passive:true})});
})();

FAQ

Frequently asked questions about content writing services.

Straight answers for users — structured answers for Google.

What’s the difference between copywriting and content writing?

Copywriting drives an action (enquiries, calls, purchases) — landing pages, ads, email sequences. Content writing builds trust + visibility (blogs, guides, SEO pages) so you attract and nurture the right audience. Most brands need both — aligned so your funnel feels consistent.

How do your SEO content writing services work?

We start with goals, then do keyword + search intent research, competitor gap analysis, and outline approval. After writing, we edit for clarity + on-page SEO (headings, internal linking, meta suggestions). You get publish-ready content — not drafts that need rewriting.

How long does it take for SEO content to show results?

SEO compounds. Early movement can happen in weeks, but meaningful traffic and lead lift typically builds over months — depending on competition, site authority, and publishing consistency. We track rankings, clicks, and conversions to show progress clearly.

Do you use AI to write content?

We use AI for research support (topic expansion, comparisons, clustering) — not for publishing generic output. Final writing and editing stays human so your content has real structure, clarity, and an on-brand voice.

Who owns the content after delivery?

You own it. Once the agreed milestone is cleared, the final approved content becomes your IP to publish and repurpose. NDA-friendly execution is available if required.

How do you measure whether the content is working?

We track outcomes: organic clicks/impressions, ranking movement, CTR, engagement, and conversions (calls/forms/enquiries), plus lead quality feedback. If the goal is leads, we optimize the conversion path — not vanity metrics.

.frag1{top:12%; right:10%; animation:fFloat1 5.8s ease-in-out infinite}
.frag2{bottom:20%; right:4%; animation:fFloat2 6.6s ease-in-out infinite}
.frag3{top:54%; left:2%; animation:fFloat3 6.2s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes fFloat1{0%,100%{transform:translate3d(0,0,30px)}50%{transform:translate3d(-12px,-16px,60px)}}
@keyframes fFloat2{0%,100%{transform:translate3d(0,0,20px)}50%{transform:translate3d(14px,-10px,50px)}}
@keyframes fFloat3{0%,100%{transform:translate3d(0,0,15px)}50%{transform:translate3d(-10px,12px,45px)}}
.hero-kinetic-lines{position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; overflow:hidden; opacity:0.18}
.hero-kinetic-lines span{position:absolute; width:1px; height:120px; background:linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, var(--purple), transparent); animation:lineFall linear infinite}
@keyframes lineFall{0%{transform:translateY(-140px)}100%{transform:translateY(780px)}}

/* Generic cards - all transparent now */
.answer-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.1fr 0.9fr; gap:28px; padding: clamp(22px, 2.8vw, 42px); border-radius:30px; background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(167,139,250,0.08), rgba(49,231,255,0.04)), var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.18); backdrop-filter:blur(22px); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(22px); width:100%}
.answer-side{display:grid; gap:12px; align-content:start}
.answer-chip{display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:center; padding:13px 15px; border-radius:16px; background:rgba(6,8,18,0.28); border:1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.14); color:#e6e8f2; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}
.answer-chip svg{width:18px; height:18px; stroke:var(--purple); stroke-width:2; fill:none}
.problem-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap: clamp(14px, 1.6vw, 24px)}
.p-card{padding: clamp(20px, 1.8vw, 28px); border-radius:26px; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); backdrop-filter:blur(18px); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px); transition:transform .4s, border-color .35s}
.p-card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px); border-color:var(--border-2); background:var(--panel-strong)}
.p-card-top{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:16px}
.p-icon{width:52px; height:52px; border-radius:16px; display:grid; place-items:center; background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,77,160,0.14), rgba(167,139,250,0.14)); border:1px solid rgba(255,77,160,0.18); color:var(--pink)}
.p-num{font-size:36px; font-weight:800; line-height:1; background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--pink), var(--purple)); -webkit-background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; background-clip:text}
.p-card h3{font-size:19px; margin:0 0 10px; font-weight:800}
.p-card p{color:var(--muted); font-size:14.5px; line-height:1.7; margin:0}
.proof-row{display:flex; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:22px}
.proof-row span{padding:9px 14px; border-radius:999px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); font-size:12px; font-weight:700}

/* SERVICES - fixed alignment to match other sections, still transparent */
.services-starfield{position:relative; width:100%; max-width:100vw; margin:0; padding: clamp(64px, 7.5vw, 128px) var(--gutter); background:transparent; border-block:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); overflow:hidden; isolation:isolate}
.services-starfield .svc-content,
.services-starfield .h2,
.services-starfield .p{margin-left:0; margin-right:0; text-align:left}
.services-starfield .svc-hint{justify-content:flex-start}
.svc-content{position:relative; z-index:2; width:100%; max-width:100%; margin:0 auto}
.svc-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3, minmax(0,1fr)); gap: clamp(14px, 1.8vw, 22px); margin-top:28px}
.svc-card{position:relative; padding: clamp(22px, 1.9vw, 28px); border-radius:22px; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); backdrop-filter:blur(18px); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px); transition:transform .35s, border-color .35s, background .35s, box-shadow .35s; cursor:pointer}
.svc-card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px); border-color:var(--border-2); background:var(--panel-strong); box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.24), 0 0 40px rgba(167,139,250,0.12)}
.svc-num{font-size:11px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:0.16em; color:var(--soft); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px}
.svc-num::before{content:""; width:22px; height:1px; background:var(--purple); display:inline-block}
.svc-card h4{font-size:19px; line-height:1.24; margin:12px 0 8px; font-weight:800}
.svc-card p{margin:0; color:var(--muted); font-size:13.8px; line-height:1.65}
.svc-line{width:28px; height:2px; background:var(--purple); margin-top:14px; transition:width .35s, background .35s}
.svc-card:hover .svc-line{width:48px; background:var(--pink)}
.svc-hint{margin-top:26px; display:flex; gap:12px; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; color:var(--soft); font-size:12px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.06em}
.svc-hint span{padding:8px 12px; border-radius:999px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06)}

/* modal */
.service-modal{position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:100; display:none; place-items:center; padding:20px; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.52); backdrop-filter:blur(22px)}
.service-modal.active{display:grid}
.modal-box{width:100%; max-width:540px; border-radius:28px; background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(22,24,48,0.92), rgba(12,14,28,0.96)); border:1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.28); padding:36px; position:relative; box-shadow:0 30px 90px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); backdrop-filter:blur(24px)}
.modal-close{position:absolute; top:14px; right:14px; width:36px; height:36px; border-radius:50%; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); color:#fff; display:grid; place-items:center; cursor:pointer}
.modal-num{font-size:11px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:0.14em; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:999px; background:rgba(167,139,250,0.12); border:1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.18); color:var(--purple)}
.modal-box h3{font-size:30px; margin:14px 0 12px; font-weight:800}
.modal-box p{color:var(--muted); font-size:15px; line-height:1.7}
.feat-list{display:grid; gap:10px; margin:18px 0 22px; padding:0}
.feat-list li{list-style:none; padding:12px 14px; border-radius:12px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); font-size:14px; font-weight:600}

/* tech */
.tech-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr); gap:16px; width:100%}
.t-card{padding:22px 18px; border-radius:22px; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); backdrop-filter:blur(16px); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px); transition:all .35s}
.t-card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px); border-color:var(--border-2); background:var(--panel-strong)}
.t-logo{width:52px; height:52px; border-radius:16px; display:grid; place-items:center; background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(167,139,250,0.14), rgba(49,231,255,0.08)); border:1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.18); color:#c9bbff; margin-bottom:16px}
.t-logo svg{width:28px; height:28px; stroke:currentColor; fill:none; stroke-width:1.8}
.t-card h3{font-size:16px; margin:0 0 8px; font-weight:800}
.t-card p{font-size:13.5px; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.6; margin:0}
.table-wrap{overflow:auto; border-radius:22px; border:1px solid var(--border); background:var(--panel); backdrop-filter:blur(18px); width:100%}
.dec-table{width:100%; min-width:720px; border-collapse:collapse}
.dec-table th{padding:18px 20px; font-size:11px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:0.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#fff; background:rgba(167,139,250,0.08); text-align:left; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06)}
.dec-table td{padding:18px 20px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color:var(--muted); font-size:14px; line-height:1.6}
.dec-table td:first-child{color:#fff; font-weight:700; width:28%}

/* process */
.process-wrap{position:relative; width:100%}
.timeline-line{position:absolute; left:50%; top:0; bottom:0; width:2px; background:linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, var(--purple) 10%, var(--pink) 50%, var(--cyan) 90%, transparent); transform:translateX(-50%); opacity:.4}
.proc-grid{display:grid; gap:26px; width:100%}
.proc-step{position:relative; display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:24px; align-items:start; width:100%}
.proc-step:nth-child(even){direction:rtl}
.proc-step:nth-child(even) *{direction:ltr}
.proc-card{padding:24px; border-radius:24px; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); backdrop-filter:blur(18px)}
.proc-card:hover{border-color:var(--border-2); transform:translateY(-4px); background:var(--panel-strong)}
.proc-num{width:46px; height:46px; border-radius:50%; display:grid; place-items:center; background:rgba(167,139,250,0.1); border:1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.3); font-weight:800; font-size:13px; color:#fff}

/* why, readiness */
.split{display:grid; grid-template-columns:0.95fr 1.05fr; gap: clamp(20px, 3vw, 42px); width:100%}
.check-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr); gap:12px}
.check-item{display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:flex-start; padding:14px; border-radius:16px; background:var(--panel-ghost); border:1px solid var(--border); font-size:13.5px; font-weight:600; backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}
.check-item svg{width:18px; height:18px; stroke:var(--purple); stroke-width:2.2; fill:none; margin-top:2px; flex-shrink:0}
.r-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:18px; width:100%}
.r-card{padding:26px; border-radius:22px; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}
.r-card h3{font-size:18px; margin:0 0 10px; font-weight:800}
.r-card p{font-size:14px; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.7; margin:0}

/* RECENT WORK - 3 SECTIONS transparent */
.recent-work{display:grid; gap: clamp(22px, 2.5vw, 36px); width:100%; margin-top:22px}
.work-section{display:grid; gap:18px; padding: clamp(20px, 2.2vw, 32px); border-radius:28px; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); backdrop-filter:blur(18px); width:100%; position:relative; overflow:hidden}
.work-section::before{content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; background:radial-gradient(circle at 12% 18%, rgba(167,139,250,0.08), transparent 42%); pointer-events:none}
.work-section-header{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-end; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap; position:relative; z-index:1}
.work-kicker{font-size:11px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:0.16em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--purple); display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center}
.work-kicker::before{content:""; width:18px; height:1px; background:var(--purple); display:inline-block}
.work-featured{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.15fr 0.85fr; gap:22px; align-items:start; position:relative; z-index:1}
.work-featured .w-img{position:relative; aspect-ratio:16/10; border-radius:20px; overflow:hidden; background:rgba(14,14,28,0.4); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06)}
.work-featured .w-img img{width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; transition:transform .6s}
.work-featured:hover .w-img img{transform:scale(1.04)}
.work-year{position:absolute; top:12px; right:12px; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:999px; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.62); border:1px solid rgba(255,159,67,0.26); color:var(--orange); font-size:11px; font-weight:800; backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.work-body h3{font-size:28px; margin:0 0 8px; font-weight:800; background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--pink), var(--orange), var(--cyan)); -webkit-background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; background-clip:text}
.work-body .w-sub{color:var(--soft); font-size:11px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.12em; text-transform:uppercase}
.work-body p{color:var(--muted); font-size:14px; line-height:1.66; margin:12px 0 16px}
.work-meta{display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap}
.work-meta span{padding:7px 10px; border-radius:999px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); font-weight:600}
.work-grid-2{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr); gap:18px; position:relative; z-index:1}
.w-card{border-radius:22px; overflow:hidden; background:rgba(10,12,24,0.32); border:1px solid var(--border); backdrop-filter:blur(14px); display:flex; flex-direction:column; transition:transform .35s, border-color .35s, background .35s}
.w-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px); border-color:var(--border-2); background:rgba(10,12,24,0.48)}
.w-card .w-img{aspect-ratio:16/10; position:relative; overflow:hidden; background:rgba(16,16,30,0.4)}
.w-card .w-img img{width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; transition:transform .6s}
.w-card:hover .w-img img{transform:scale(1.06)}
.w-card .w-body{padding:18px}
.w-card .w-body h4{font-size:20px; margin:0 0 6px; font-weight:800}
.work-closing{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 0.9fr; gap:18px; align-items:stretch; position:relative; z-index:1}
.cta-panel{border-radius:22px; padding:26px; background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(167,139,250,0.12), rgba(255,77,160,0.12)); border:1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.22); display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}

/* AMC */
.amc-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:18px; width:100%}
.amc-card{position:relative; padding:28px; border-radius:24px; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); backdrop-filter:blur(16px); transition:all .35s}
.amc-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px); background:var(--panel-strong)}
.amc-num{font-size:64px; font-weight:900; line-height:1; opacity:0.12; background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple), var(--pink)); -webkit-background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; background-clip:text}
.logos-wrap{margin-top:32px; padding:32px; border-radius:28px; background:var(--panel-ghost); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); backdrop-filter:blur(14px); width:100%}
.logos-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(5, minmax(0,1fr)); gap:18px; width:100%}
.logo-item{display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:10px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.02); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border-radius:18px; padding:18px; transition:.3s}
.logo-item img{width:100%; max-width:112px; height:48px; object-fit:contain}
.logo-item span{font-size:11px; font-weight:700; color:var(--soft); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.08em; text-align:center}

/* cost */
.cost-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:18px; width:100%}
.cost-card{padding:26px; border-radius:22px; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}

/* FAQ */
.faq-wrap{max-width:980px; margin:0 auto; width:100%}
.faq-list{display:grid; gap:14px}
.faq-item{border-radius:18px; background:var(--panel-ghost); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); overflow:hidden; backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}
.faq-item.active{border-color:rgba(255,77,160,0.38); background:rgba(255,77,160,0.06)}
.faq-q{width:100%; text-align:left; background:transparent; border:0; color:#fff; padding:20px 22px; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:16px; cursor:pointer; font-size:16px; font-weight:700}
.faq-icon{width:34px; height:34px; border-radius:50%; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14); display:grid; place-items:center; flex-shrink:0; transition:all .3s; font-size:18px}
.faq-item.active .faq-icon{transform:rotate(45deg); border-color:var(--pink); background:rgba(255,77,160,0.1)}
.faq-a{display:grid; grid-template-rows:0fr; transition:grid-template-rows .35s}
.faq-item.active .faq-a{grid-template-rows:1fr}
.faq-a-inner{overflow:hidden}
.faq-a-inner p{padding:0 22px 22px; margin:0; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.7; font-size:14.5px}
.form-glass{margin-top:38px; padding: clamp(20px, 2.6vw, 36px); border-radius:28px; background:var(--panel-ghost); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); backdrop-filter:blur(18px); width:100%}
.form-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:14px; width:100%}
.input{width:100%; padding:14px 16px; border-radius:12px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color:#fff; font-size:14px; outline:none}
.input:focus{border-color:rgba(167,139,250,0.4); background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05)}
textarea.input{grid-column:1/-1; min-height:120px; resize:vertical}

/* 4K */
@media (min-width: 1920px){
  :root{ --gutter: clamp(64px, 4.5vw, 120px); }
  .section{ padding: clamp(88px, 6vw, 160px) var(--gutter); }
  .h2{ font-size: clamp(44px, 3.2vw, 76px); }
  .hero-h1{ font-size: clamp(54px, 4.6vw, 104px) }
}
@media (min-width: 2560px){
  :root{ --gutter: clamp(96px, 5vw, 180px); }
  html{ font-size:17px }
  #globalStarfield{ opacity:1 }
}
@media (max-width: 1180px){
  .hero{grid-template-columns:1fr; min-height:auto}
  .hero{padding-top:clamp(96px,11vw,132px)}
  .hero-visual{height:clamp(580px,72vw,700px); order:-1; padding-block:36px}
  .svc-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .problem-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .tech-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
  .r-grid,.cost-grid,.amc-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .logos-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
  .split{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .proc-step{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .timeline-line{left:18px; transform:none}
  .work-featured, .work-grid-2, .work-closing{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .services-starfield{margin-left:0; margin-right:0; width:100%; max-width:100vw}
}
@media (max-width: 760px){
  :root{ --gutter: 18px }
  .section{padding:56px var(--gutter)}
  .hero{padding-top:clamp(88px,20vw,118px)}
  .hero-visual{height:460px; padding-block:34px; margin-bottom:8px}
  .hero-scene{transform:translateY(14px)}
  .problem-grid,.tech-grid,.r-grid,.cost-grid,.amc-grid,.form-grid,.check-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .logos-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .svc-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .cursor-dot,.cursor-ring{display:none!important}
  .ring3{display:none}
}
@media (max-width: 380px){
  :root{ --gutter: 14px }
  .btn{width:100%; justify-content:center}
}


/* =========================================================
   DGS HARD OVERRIDES: TRANSPARENT PAGE + GLOBAL STARFIELD
   These selectors intentionally use high specificity and
   !important so WordPress/theme/Elementor backgrounds cannot
   cover the fixed starfield canvas.
   ========================================================= */
html{
  background:#050508 !important;
  background-color:#050508 !important;
}
html body.dgs-webdev-active,
html body.dgs-webdev-active #page,
html body.dgs-webdev-active .site,
html body.dgs-webdev-active .site-content,
html body.dgs-webdev-active .site-main,
html body.dgs-webdev-active .content-area,
html body.dgs-webdev-active .content-wrap,
html body.dgs-webdev-active .content-wrapper,
html body.dgs-webdev-active .entry-content,
html body.dgs-webdev-active article,
html body.dgs-webdev-active main,
html body.dgs-webdev-active main > section,
html body.dgs-webdev-active .section,
html body.dgs-webdev-active .services-starfield,
html body.dgs-webdev-active .elementor,
html body.dgs-webdev-active .elementor-location-single,
html body.dgs-webdev-active .elementor-page,
html body.dgs-webdev-active .elementor-section,
html body.dgs-webdev-active .elementor-section-wrap,
html body.dgs-webdev-active .elementor-container,
html body.dgs-webdev-active .elementor-column,
html body.dgs-webdev-active .elementor-column-wrap,
html body.dgs-webdev-active .elementor-widget-wrap,
html body.dgs-webdev-active .elementor-element,
html body.dgs-webdev-active .e-con,
html body.dgs-webdev-active .e-con-inner,
html body.dgs-webdev-active .wp-site-blocks,
html body.dgs-webdev-active .wp-block-group,
html body.dgs-webdev-active .ast-container,
html body.dgs-webdev-active .site-content > .ast-container{
  background:transparent !important;
  background-color:transparent !important;
  background-image:none !important;
}

html body.dgs-webdev-active::before{
  content:"";
  position:fixed;
  inset:0;
  z-index:-2;
  pointer-events:none;
  background:#050508 !important;
}

html body.dgs-webdev-active #globalStarfield{
  display:block !important;
  visibility:visible !important;
  opacity:.95 !important;
  background:transparent !important;
  z-index:0 !important;
}

html body.dgs-webdev-active .global-mesh{
  background:transparent !important;
  z-index:1 !important;
}

html body.dgs-webdev-active main{
  isolation:isolate;

<h2 class="h2">How to Choose Among the <i>Best Website Development Companies in Mumbai</i></h2>
<p class="p">The best website development company for a business is not simply the company using the loudest promotional language. A top website development company in Mumbai should demonstrate relevant work, explain its process and connect design decisions to search visibility, usability and enquiries. Businesses searching for SEO websites in Mumbai or a website dev company in Mumbai generally need the same fundamentals: useful content, crawlable architecture, responsive development, dependable performance and ongoing support.</p>
<div class="decision-grid">
<article class="decision-card"><span aria-hidden="true" class="decision-icon">01</span><div><h3>Relevant project evidence</h3><p>Review projects with similar business models, content volume, integrations or customer journeys. Ask what problem was solved and what was delivered.</p></div></article>
<article class="decision-card"><span aria-hidden="true" class="decision-icon">02</span><div><h3>Strategy before visual design</h3><p>The sitemap, page purpose, user intent and conversion journey should be clear before visual layouts and animations are finalised.</p></div></article>
<article class="decision-card"><span aria-hidden="true" class="decision-icon">03</span><div><h3>Technology based on need</h3><p>A credible website dev company should explain why WordPress, Next.js, React, PHP or another approach is suitable for the project.</p></div></article>
<article class="decision-card"><span aria-hidden="true" class="decision-icon">04</span><div><h3>SEO-ready architecture</h3><p>Clean URLs, semantic headings, crawlable links, metadata controls, migration planning and page performance should be included in development decisions.</p></div></article>
<article class="decision-card"><span aria-hidden="true" class="decision-icon">05</span><div><h3>Measurement and lead journeys</h3><p>Forms, calls to action, GA4, GTM and conversion events should connect website activity to genuine enquiries and business outcomes.</p></div></article>
<article class="decision-card"><span aria-hidden="true" class="decision-icon">06</span><div><h3>Support after launch</h3><p>Clarify ownership, backups, software updates, content changes, performance reviews, response times and website AMC responsibilities.</p></div></article>
</div>

<section class="section compact-section" id="development-process">
<div class="section-label"><span class="dot"></span> Website Development Process</div>
<h2 class="h2">A Clear Process from <i>Discovery to Launch and AMC</i></h2>
<p class="p">A structured process reduces avoidable revisions, keeps content and development aligned and makes technical responsibilities clear before launch.</p>
<div class="process-grid-new">
<article class="process-step-new"><span>01</span><h3>Discovery and objectives</h3><p>Business goals, audience, competitors, content, integrations, timelines and measurable conversion priorities.</p></article>
<article class="process-step-new"><span>02</span><h3>Sitemap and search planning</h3><p>Page hierarchy, keyword intent, navigation, internal links, URL structure and content requirements.</p></article>
<article class="process-step-new"><span>03</span><h3>UI/UX and content flow</h3><p>Responsive layouts, visual hierarchy, trust signals, calls to action and reusable component planning.</p></article>
<article class="process-step-new"><span>04</span><h3>Development and integrations</h3><p>CMS or custom build, forms, APIs, analytics, technical SEO controls and reusable frontend components.</p></article>
<article class="process-step-new"><span>05</span><h3>QA, migration and launch</h3><p>Device testing, performance checks, redirects, metadata, forms, analytics, indexing and launch validation.</p></article>
<article class="process-step-new"><span>06</span><h3>Measurement and AMC</h3><p>Post-launch monitoring, content updates, technical support, security, backups and improvement planning.</p></article>
</div>
</section>
<section class="section compact-section" id="industries">
<div class="section-label"><span class="dot"></span> Industries and Website Requirements</div>
<h2 class="h2">Website Development for <i>Different Business Models</i></h2>
<p class="p">Industry experience matters because page structure, trust signals, content depth, integrations and enquiry journeys vary by business model. Our approach adapts the technology and content architecture rather than forcing every project into the same template.</p>
<div class="industry-grid">
<article><h3>B2B and professional services</h3><p>Clear service architecture, expertise proof, case studies, lead qualification and decision-maker journeys.</p></article>
<article><h3>Finance and regulated categories</h3><p>Structured information, trust, disclosures, accessible content, controlled updates and secure enquiry paths.</p></article>
<article><h3>Education and training</h3><p>Programme discovery, admission enquiries, faculty and credibility content, events and scalable publishing.</p></article>
<article><h3>Staffing and workforce solutions</h3><p>Employer and candidate journeys, service discovery, location content, lead forms and recruitment workflows.</p></article>
<article><h3>Consumer and lifestyle brands</h3><p>Brand storytelling, product or service discovery, campaigns, mobile-first experiences and conversion tracking.</p></article>
<article><h3>Technology and sustainability</h3><p>Complex proposition explanation, solution architecture, credibility signals, resources and investor or partner journeys.</p></article>
</div>
</section>
<section class="section" id="amc">
<div class="section-label"><span class="dot"></span> Website Maintenance & AMC</div>
<h2 class="h2">Annual Maintenance Contracts for <i>Long-Term Website Stability</i></h2>
<p class="p">Website AMC keeps the live website monitored, updated, backed up and ready for ongoing business changes. The exact support plan is defined according to the platform, website size, update frequency and response requirements.</p>
<div class="amc-grid" style="margin-top:22px">
<article class="amc-card"><div class="amc-num">01</div><h3 style="font-weight:800">Proactive Monitoring</h3><p class="p" style="font-size:14px">Scheduled uptime, form and performance checks with issue alerts and documented follow-up.</p></article>
<article class="amc-card"><div class="amc-num">02</div><h3 style="font-weight:800">Security & Backups</h3><p class="p" style="font-size:14px">Security reviews, malware checks, backup management and recovery support according to the agreed plan.</p></article>
<article class="amc-card"><div class="amc-num">03</div><h3 style="font-weight:800">Regular Updates</h3><p class="p" style="font-size:14px">WordPress core, theme and plugin updates with compatibility checks and staged testing where applicable.</p></article>
<article class="amc-card"><div class="amc-num">04</div><h3 style="font-weight:800">Performance Tuning</h3><p class="p" style="font-size:14px">Caching, image delivery, script review, database housekeeping and Core Web Vitals monitoring.</p></article>
<article class="amc-card"><div class="amc-num">05</div><h3 style="font-weight:800">Content Support</h3><p class="p" style="font-size:14px">Planned updates to pages, banners, blogs, forms and campaign content within the AMC scope.</p></article>
<article class="amc-card"><div class="amc-num">06</div><h3 style="font-weight:800">Technical Support</h3><p class="p" style="font-size:14px">Issue resolution, change requests, integration assistance and technical guidance for the website team.</p></article>
</div>

(function initGlobalStarfield(){

      this.y=(Math.random()-.5)*height*1.35;
      this.z=initial?Math.random()*1500+160:Math.random()*1050+500;

    centerX=width*.5;
    centerY=height*.5;

    pointerTargetY=centerY;

    if(hidden) return;

    const dt60=elapsed/16.6667;
    lastUpdate=now;
    lastRender=now-(now-lastRender)%frameInterval;

    pointerY+=(pointerTargetY-pointerY)*pointerEase;

    const cy=centerY+(pointerY-centerY)*.10;
